notes.title: New Skimmer Updates Splash onto the Scene with Visions of Eternity
notes.content:
[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/5ef6bgw027.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/5ef6bgw027-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


Back in July, [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/news/announcing-guild-wars-2-visions-of-eternity/]we announced[/url] that a set of new and updated mechanics for the skimmer would arrive with the launch of [i]Guild Wars 2®: Visions of Eternity™[/i]. Today, we're excited to share more details, including some exciting boosts for those with the previous Skimmer Mount Mastery line trained.
 
To see the [i]Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity[/i] skimmers—including the new abilities in action—join us for a livestream on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/guildwars2]Twitch channel[/url] this Friday, September 19, at noon Pacific Time (UTC-7).
 
[h1]A Home Called Castora[/h1]
 
During your time in Castora, you will likely stumble upon a new, yet familiar, creature that calls this island home. Wavehawks—otherwise known as skimmers in Elonian local parlance—are masters of both sea and sky. They've adapted to the island's rich energies—and, when tamed, they become a valuable asset for those attempting to survive on Castora.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/6fc48gw090.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/6fc48gw090-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]
 

[h1]Divergent Evolution[/h1]
 
Unlike the skimmers that reside in the deserts of Elona, these skimmers evolved in a setting rich with ley magic that runs through root and sand. This has turned the wavehawks into highly mobile mounts that can navigate with ease and grace over all kinds of terrain, as well as boasting some new combat and exploration abilities:

[list][*][b]Aetherlocation:[/b] A pulsing, sonar-like signal that detects nearby threats and enemies. While submerged, it also has the ability to detect hidden treasures throughout the waters of Tyria.[/*]
[*][b]Slipstream Boost:[/b] Increases the base speed of the skimmer for a set duration. During this time, using the Hover skill also increases the vertical height gain of the skimmer past previous limits at the cost of stamina.[/*]
[*][b]Water Jets:[/b] Commands the skimmer to fire a set of projectiles that damages enemies and heals allies. When it is held, the ability will continue to fire up to max ammo count.[/*][/list] 


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/ea5bfgw083.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/ea5bfgw083-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]
 

[h1]Training Your Skimmer[/h1]
 
Once unlocked, you will learn to master the skimmer's new abilities throughout your Castoran adventure. For those with the previous skimmer masteries from [i]Guild Wars 2: Path of Fire™[/i], you'll see a boost to the existing Masteries to take your mount to new heights:

[list][*][b]Advanced Hydrodynamics:[/b] Grants your skimmer the ability to dive underwater. For those who already have this ability with Skimming the Depths trained, it will also increase the base speed of the skimmer as well as grant temporary stealth when diving into and out of water.[/*]
[*][b]Castoran Intuition:[/b] Unlocks the skimmer's ability to use Aetherlocation while also enhancing the Barrel Roll engage skill. This enhanced version of the skill allows for multiple dashes without dismounting at the cost of stamina. When it is held, the ability will activate its dismount portion of the skill.[/*]
[*][b]Convergent Evolution:[/b] Unlocks the skimmer's Slipstream Boost and Water Jets skills. For those with Ride the Wind trained, it will further increase the aerial ascent power of Hover High while Slipstream Boost is active.[/*]
[*][b]Riptide Rider:[/b] Grants your skimmer the ability to ride ley lines and updrafts both above and within the water.[/*][/list]
 
Alongside these enhancements, all versions of the skimmer—regardless of Mastery or acquisition method—will also be getting base-level updates. Players will now be able to dismount the skimmer in midair and can mount it in combat with no Mastery training required.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/7d142gw109.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/7d142gw109-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]
 
 
[h1]Livestream This Friday[/h1]
 
Everything we discussed today and more will be shown in detail during our livestream this week! Tune in to our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/guildwars2]Twitch channel[/url] this Friday, September 19, at noon Pacific Time (UTC-7) to see it all for yourself. Get ready to soar over the island of Castora on your very own wavehawk on October 28. Prepurchase [url=https://buy.guildwars2.com/visions-of-eternity][i]Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity[/i][/url] and unlock some of the digital rewards today!

[previewyoutube=LEdxbIU11so;full][/previewyoutube]

-Slipstream Boost: Increases the base speed of the skimmer for a set duration. During this time, using the Hover skill also increases the vertical height gain of the skimmer past previous limits at the cost of stamina.
-Water Jets: Commands the skimmer to fire a set of projectiles that damages enemies and heals allies. When it is held, the ability will continue to fire up to max ammo count.

-Advanced Hydrodynamics: Grants your skimmer the ability to dive underwater. For those who already have this ability with Skimming the Depths trained, it will also increase the base speed of the skimmer as well as grant temporary stealth when diving into and out of water.

-Castoran Intuition: Unlocks the skimmer's ability to use Aetherlocation while also enhancing the Barrel Roll engage skill. This enhanced version of the skill allows for multiple dashes without dismounting at the cost of stamina. When it is held, the ability will activate its dismount portion of the skill.

-Convergent Evolution: Unlocks the skimmer's Slipstream Boost and Water Jets skills. For those with Ride the Wind trained, it will further increase the aerial ascent power of Hover High while Slipstream Boost is active.
-Riptide Rider: Grants your skimmer the ability to ride ley lines and updrafts both above and within the water.

notes.title: A Surprise Fractal Incursion with New Rewards Awaits You Today!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ef3W7pnOsiQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/a87eaenUS-gw2-fractal-incursions-promo-1920x1080-1.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/a87eaenUS-gw2-fractal-incursions-promo-1920x1080-1-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


[b][i]The Mists tremble and warp as the impact of recent events permeates the beyond. The Astral Ward has named it a fractal incursion, as Tyria risks a deluge of malicious attacks from fractal recreations.

I am calling for your aid to stabilize the disturbance via the Fractals of the Mists in Lion's Arch. Let us meet there, and I will explain how we may avert this crisis.

—Mist Stranger[/i][/b]

Surprise! Today we're introducing a brand-new bonus event called Fractal Incursion that will run until October 7 at 12:00 p.m. Pacific Time (UTC-7). This event is aimed at introducing new players to fractals and giving fractal veterans more rewards to seek, including an incredible pair of legendary gloves!  We also have some updates for our new PvP game mode, Push.

The mysterious Mist Stranger calls for your aid with a plan formed alongside the Astral Ward to calm the Mists. Join them in Lion's Arch to embark on an adventure into the Fractals of the Mists and across Tyria! All of today's live content updates are free and accessible to all players regardless of expansion ownership. Let's dive in!

[h1]Introducing the Quickplay Beta[/h1]


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/e9a06enUS-gw2-fractal-incursions-promo-1920x1080-3.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/e9a06enUS-gw2-fractal-incursions-promo-1920x1080-3-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


This event introduces a new way to play fractals called quickplay mode, which we're now beta testing with the community. Quickplay will automatically pair you with other adventurers and launch you into a curated list of scale 1 fractals. You can use this new feature when you're solo, in a full group, or in a partial group, and quickplay will do the rest!
 
Quickplay mode is accessed through the Fractal of the Mists (Initiate Scales 1–25) section of the Looking for Group panel or by clicking the red banner outside the fractal portal in Lion's Arch. The current set of fractals available for quickplay includes:
 
[list][*]Aetherblade[/*]
[*]Cliffside[/*]
[*]Deepstone[/*]
[*]Kinfall[/*]
[*]Molten Boss[/*]
[*]Molten Furnace[/*]
[*]Snowblind[/*]
[*]Uncategorized[/*]
[*]Urban Battleground[/*]
[*]Volcanic[/*][/list]

The Mist Stranger will also assist players using the quickplay mode queue by helping to revive fallen adventurers and overcome environmental puzzles. For more information about this and some other changes to the fractals themselves, please refer to our [url=https://en-forum.guildwars2.com/topic/162207-game-update-notes-september-9-2025/]full release notes[/url] for today's update.

[h1]Open-World Incursions[/h1]


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/4843cenUS-gw2-fractal-incursions-promo-1920x1080-2.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/4843cenUS-gw2-fractal-incursions-promo-1920x1080-2-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


Enemies from the fractals are spilling into the open world! You'll need to safeguard Tyria from the Mists' creatures during these new events at the top of every hour in one of these zones: Snowden Drifts, Diessa Plateau, Kessex Hills, and Brisban Wildlands. Don't fret if you travel to the wrong zone, though—portals will appear in the others to lead you to where the problem is!

These events will award participants with achievement progress and a sampling of agony resistance infusions to assist heroes in preparing for more challenging fractals.

[h1]Fractally Amazing Rewards[/h1]

[youtube_inline id=ef3W7pnOsiQ]

Participating in this month-long event can earn you significant rewards! The Fractal Incursion Champion achievement is only available during the event and offers players twenty-two different reward tiers. The final reward of this achievement chain is the Legendary Weapon Starter Key—Universal, which allows you to kickstart your progress toward any first-generation legendary weapon!

Other rewards include:

[list][*]A full set of rare-quality equipment for fresh level 80 characters.[/*]
[*]Exotic armor, weapons, and accessories, including the new Guild Captain's Cape.[/*]
[*]A new ascended accessory with agony resistance, the Fractal Sheriff's Star.[/*]
[*]Two Bag Slot Expansions and a 20-slot bag.[/*][/list]
 
There's also a set of new achievements and rewards that are now permanent additions to the game. The Incursive Investigation achievements will guide you through the effort to stop the incursion attacks with a new section of the journey unlocking each week over the first three weeks of the event. The final reward for completing these achievements is the legendary Eikasia, Mists-Grasper gloves!

These gloves allow you to project a magical aura around the tip of whichever weapon you're wielding. Over time, you can earn all three armor weights of these gloves and a series of Agony Lens infusions that let you customize the color of Eikasia's glow on each weapon you wield!
 
Lastly, check the Wizard's Vault for some bonus objectives and new rewards, including 20 Lucent Crystal Vault Bags, 3 Mystic Coin Vault Bags, a Lesser Essence of Gold, and an Infinite Mist Omnipotion.

[h1]Push Is Launching Today![/h1]


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/06270PvPPushcart2K.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/06270PvPPushcart2K-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


Almost exactly a year ago today, we [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/news/introducing-push-a-new-pvp-game-mode/]unveiled our plans[/url] to develop a new PvP mode alongside the community. After three beta events, countless changes based on player feedback, new map art, and new UI elements, we're finally launching Push out of beta and into full release. PvP players can hop into the game right now and play Push. This game mode is here to stay!
 
In our most recent beta, we collected some great feedback from you, and our team has implemented the following notable changes:
  
[list][*]Adjusted Mortal Contest and global healing reductions to reduce barrier support effectiveness.[/*]
[*]Changed the locations of secondary objectives and updated their interaction-point art.[/*]
[*]The visual effects for the center objective have been updated to better fit the setting.[/*]
[*]Interactable teleports have been added to increase the variety of map pathing.[/*]
[*]We've made some additional map adjustments, including the removal of ramps near player spawn points to avoid pregame griefing.[/*][/list]
 
While Push is now live, we'll continue to monitor feedback and make adjustments to the game mode as needed to ensure it's as fun and competitive as possible. Thank you for your assistance in making Push come to life, and we'll see you in the Sunjiang Backstreets very soon!

notes.title: Stay Cozy and Warm with the Austral Mantle Skin
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=CsdCaguLWhQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Austral Mantle Skin[/h1]

The days are getting colder as autumn approaches. Get ready to feel cozy and warm with a beautiful garment designed to allow freedom of movement. The patterned poncho is adorned with lovely details, and the undershirt is crafted with high-quality textiles. The Austral Mantle Skin is available for 400 gems.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/8c08bgw203.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/8c08bgw203-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Black Lion Chest Update: Seasoned Hunter Chest[/h1]

Inside each chest, you're guaranteed to find a redeemable Black Lion Statuette, a Mini Green Turtle Hatchling, and two common items. You also have a chance to find something rarer in the fifth slot, including special items, glyphs, and skins from the Venombite Weapon Collection and the White Tiger Weapon Collection.

The Mini Green Turtle Hatchling is a new mini to grow your collection. Use the Mystic Forge to combine the Mini Green Turtle Hatchling into different variants, such as the Mini Blue Turtle Hatchling, Mini Albino Turtle Hatchling, Mini Celestial Turtle Hatchling, and more!


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/3a825gw027.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/3a825gw027-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Exclusive Item: "/Barbecue" Emote Tome[/h1]

Spend the rest of your late-summer days cooking up delicious barbecue meals for all your friends. Type /barbecue, /bbq, and /grill in the chat to start your feast. The "/Barbecue" Emote Tome is a new, exclusive drop from Black Lion Chests.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/2a6bagw010.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/2a6bagw010-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


[b]Shade-Touched Weapon Collection[/b]

Caressed by darkness, these weapons are imbued with an ancient power harnessed by necromancers of ages past. Let their chilling metal and blue gloom guide you in battle. Each Shade-Touched weapon skin can be obtained in exchange for 1 Black Lion Claim Ticket.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/735b1Gw2Dev-64-2025-08-29-15-48-57-37.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/735b1Gw2Dev-64-2025-08-29-15-48-57-37-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]The Sensational Storage Package Returns![/h1]

It's back! Pick up this valuable bundle and upgrade your account today. This package is available until September 23 and can only be purchased once per account—but don't worry, if you've purchased it before, you can obtain it again this time around! The Sensational Storage Package is 1,500 gems and contains the following items: Bag Slot Expansion, Shared Inventory Slot, 20 Slot Black Lion Satchel, Bank Tab Expansion, and Material Storage Expander.

[h1]What's in Stock[/h1]

We're getting ready to rotate some goodies on Friday, September 12! These will be 20% off until September 26. Check out some of our favorites, like the Astral Scholar Outfit, Mist Stranger Outfit, Adventurous Cat Outfit, Infused Samurai Outfit, and Mage Knight Outfit!

[b]Returning This Week[/b]

Free your artistic mind and design a whole new hero! From today until September 16, Character Slot Expansions are available at a 20% discount.

notes.title: Home Improvement: A New Homestead Arrives with Visions of Eternity
notes.content:
[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/00d6fHomesteadBlog-gw616.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/00d6fHomesteadBlog-gw616-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]
 

Back in July, [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/news/announcing-guild-wars-2-visions-of-eternity/]we announced[/url] that a new homestead map would arrive with the launch of [i]Guild Wars 2®: Visions of Eternity™[/i]. Today, we're thrilled to share more details about it, along with some exciting quality-of-life improvements. These enhancements will be available to anyone with access to homesteads, which requires ownership of [url=https://buy.guildwars2.com/janthir-wilds][i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds™[/i][/url]. Players who also own [i]Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity[/i] will get a magical new map to decorate called Comosus Isle.
 
To see everything we're talking about today—including the new map—join us for a livestream on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/guildwars2]Twitch channel[/url] this Friday, September 5, at noon Pacific Time (UTC-7).
 

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/fa0b5HomesteadBlog-gw590.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/fa0b5HomesteadBlog-gw590-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]
 
 
[h1]Your Very Own Private Island Getaway[/h1]

Looking to take a break from the pressures that come with being the commander and wayfinder? Talk to Deft Lahar in your homestead, and he'll set you up with your very own private island in a Castoran paradise.
 
Start your day on Comosus Isle by hanging out at the beach's fishing spots or by enjoying a guided ley-line tour that takes you on a scenic journey around the dazzling mountain bursting with energy. Thrill seekers can dive through the top of the mountain to the otherworldly caverns below, and explorers looking for a more relaxed time can hike through the hidden tunnels to get there instead. Once there, wash your worries away in the bubbling pool and let the crystal resonance of the area revitalize you.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/e4735HomesteadBlog-gw581.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/e4735HomesteadBlog-gw581-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]
 

Your new vacation home is a three-story suite that comes fully furnished with a sitting and dining area, kitchen, bedroom, and a balcony where you can enjoy the ocean view in private. If you're looking for a livelier time, you can wander over to the attached club hangout area.

If you'd prefer not to have a house on your island, fear not! The house—and every decoration it's made from—can be removed and stored in your decoration inventory. They're yours to keep! You can construct a new house just the way you like it or remove it entirely and customize the look of your island getaway.

[h1]Home Improvement[/h1]

So, you've decided to pack up all your stuff in Hearth's Glow and move to paradise? Before you go, consider using the new decoration layout feature to make a record of all your carefully placed decorations. That way, if you get sunburned a little too easily, you can move back and get all your furniture set up again with just a few clicks. Are you a big fan of Wintersday? Save a festive layout for your homestead that you can swap to in seconds when the season arrives!
 
The best part is that you can share your layouts with others! Layouts are stored as XML files that you can freely share with anyone you like. We can't wait for the expert interior decorators in our community to share their amazing designs with everyone! Please note that layouts are stored locally, so if you play [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] on multiple devices, you'll need to copy your layout files over.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/971a5HomesteadBlog-gw586.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/971a5HomesteadBlog-gw586-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]
 
 
When you load a layout into your homestead, it will only place the decorations that you have crafted and own. You'll also be shown a list of the decorations that you're missing so you know what you'll need to go make!
 
You can also save the layout of a homestead you're currently visiting. Maybe you aren't much of a decorator yourself, but you’ve been impressed by all the amazing work you've seen in your friend's homestead? Ask them to enable the Party Layout Saving option while you're visiting, and you'll be able to save their layout and import it into your own home!


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/3cfc4HomesteadBlog-gw593.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/3cfc4HomesteadBlog-gw593-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

 
Finally, we're adding a new option to make decorating your homestead a bit easier. A Place Duplicate skill will be added to the Modify Existing Decorations mode and will allow you to use an already-placed decoration to guide your alignment of a new decoration. This alleviates the need to manually align decorations when you're building things like walls or fences.
 
To utilize this feature, edit an existing decoration and position it to where you'd like your next piece to go. Then use the new Place Duplicate skill instead of Confirm Modification. Assuming you have more of that decoration available in your storage, it will place it in the newly selected area and leave the existing decoration where it was before. This is definitely easier to visualize with a video:

[previewyoutube=kSa-5Ls7FoQ;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[h1]Livestream This Friday[/h1]

We can't wait for you to see Comosus Isle and all of the wondrous locations there are to explore within. This gorgeous map and the features we discussed today will be shown in detail during our livestream this week. Tune in to our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/guildwars2]Twitch channel[/url] this Friday, September 5 at noon Pacific Time (UTC-7) to see it all for yourself. And if this sounds like the all-inclusive resort experience for you, you can prepurchase [url=https://buy.guildwars2.com/visions-of-eternity][i]Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity[/i][/url] and unlock some of the [url=https://youtu.be/LEdxbIU11so]digital rewards[/url] today!


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/6f033HomesteadBlog-gw598.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/6f033HomesteadBlog-gw598-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Have a Blast with These New Skritt-tastic Gathering Tools!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=oqwvdw5xAN0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Prospector's Gathering Tools[/h1]

Employ the help of overenthusiastic skritt to explode gathering nodes and collect all the shiny materials you desire! Disclaimer: No skritt will be harmed in the gathering of these nodes.

The Prospector's Gathering Tools include the Prospector's Mining Tool, Prospector's Logging Tool, Prospector's Harvesting Tool, and 3 Black Lion Glyph Selection Containers and is available for 2,700 gems.

notes.title: The Final Three Elite Specializations: Elementalist, Engineer, Revenant
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=mBxqT0_XSfo;full][/previewyoutube]

Today, we're unveiling the final three elite specializations coming to [i]Guild Wars 2®: Visions of Eternity™[/i]! If you missed our previous reveals, make sure you check out the elite specs blogs for the [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/news/elite-specializations-are-back-mesmer-ranger-and-guardian]mesmer, ranger, and guardian[/url] and the [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/news/elite-specialization-reveal-thief-necromancer-and-warrior/]thief, necromancer, and warrior[/url]!

Before we dive into the details for the revenant, elementalist, and engineer, make sure you tune into our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/guildwars2]Twitch channel[/url] this Friday, August 8, at 12:00 p.m. Pacific Time (UTC-7) for a live preview of the three elite specializations we're talking about today. You'll also be able to play all of the elite specializations yourself during our beta event from August 20 at 9:00 a.m. Pacific Time (UTC-7) until August 27 at 10:00 p.m. Pacific Time (UTC-7).


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/ca954gw2-ex6-voe-espec-blog-ele-1920x1080.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/ca954gw2-ex6-voe-espec-blog-ele-1920x1080-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

 
[h1]The Evoker: Spiritual Summoners[/h1]

Having toppled the powerful jotun civilization in the previous dragonrise, Jormag was poised to claim the Shiverpeaks and beyond when they awoke once again. However, as the dragon's influence crept south of the mountainous crown, displacing the various kodan sanctuaries, it collided with the stalwart and courageous resolve of the norn and their ever-watching guides, the Spirits of Wild.
 
Despite their resistance, Jormag's campaign left lasting scars on many of the spirits, consuming or corrupting those that held the line. In the years since Jormag's defeat, the norn have made strides to reconnect and commune with the spirits. Many now turn to old practices that harken to a time when the first pacts that entwined both groups in spiritual harmony were spoken—the centuries-old tradition of the evoker. 
 
Drawing upon the forces of the natural world, these norn elementalists call upon spiritual companions and empower them with elemental energies. At the spirits' behest, the norn have been encouraged to share this practice beyond their own to help restore and heal Tyria's nature spirits.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/8733dEspec-Video03-001.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/8733dEspec-Video03-001-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

  
[b][h3]Familiar Friends[/h3][/b]

Every evoker starts with a choice: Which element do you want to specialize in? Selecting an elemental skill on the F5 slot will specialize in that element, granting a few bonuses. First, the attunement skill for that element will have a significantly reduced recharge time. In addition, some of the evoker's traits and utility skills will be affected by your chosen element. And most importantly, a familiar of that element will join you on your adventures.

Fire specialists will be accompanied by the cunning fox, water joined by the mischievous otter, air by the agile hare, while earth gets the stalwart toad. The familiar has two different skills that are available in the F5 slot once they are fully charged: a basic skill and an empowered skill. The basic skill is charged as the evoker uses their own weapon skills, requiring a total of six to fully charge. Weapon skills that match the familiar's element will count for double, meaning that only three fire attunement skills would be required to fully charge the fox's skill. The familiar's empowered skill will unlock after using its basic skill three times, and that's when the evoker (and their familiar) unleash their full potential.
 
The evoker is a flexible specialization, capable of filling a number of roles depending on which element you specialize in. Those leaning toward fire may choose to focus on condition damage, as the fox will complement those builds well.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/7084aEspec-Video03-012.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/7084aEspec-Video03-012-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

 
[b][h3]Fiery Foxes[/h3][/b]

The fox's basic skill is called Ignite. When activated, the fox will launch a fiery missile at your target, dealing some damage and inflicting burning, and enemies struck by this skill in quick succession will receive additional stacks of burning.
 
After using Ignite three times, and hopefully inflicting a good chunk of burning, evokers will gain access to the fox's empowered skill: Conflagration. Using this skill will summon the fox near your target, after which it will perform a leaping strike that inflicts burning and also spreads any burning from that target to nearby enemies (up to a limit—we thought that spreading 1,500 burning stacks might be a bit too powerful).

Tune in to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/guildwars2]our stream[/url] this Friday for a full reveal of the other spirit companions and their abilities!


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/89ff8gw2-ex6-voe-espec-blog-engi-1920x1080.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/89ff8gw2-ex6-voe-espec-blog-engi-1920x1080-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

 
[h1]The Amalgam: Oozing with Power[/h1]

Asuran scientists have studied, manipulated, transformed, and occasionally displaced oozes at every level of scientific research. Endlessly adaptable, oozes can absorb the properties of substances and living creatures they come into contact with—and a recent breakthrough has allowed them to be used as a powerful tool for both defense and offense.
  
The mercurial mold is a special species of ooze that can form a symbiotic bond with its owner and interpret their needs in battle. It's lightweight, responds instantly, requires no special feeding, and—best of all—no fatalities have been reported as a result of the bonding process. Why not give it a try?


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/d8983Espec-Video03-022.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/d8983Espec-Video03-022-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

 
[b][h3]Slime Time[/h3][/b]

Bonded with their mercurial mold, amalgams are engineers with unparalleled adaptive capabilities. By being able to freely customize which morph skills they select, you can arrive to any fight with the right tools to survive and dish out damage. Amalgams can temporarily meld with their slime, resulting in an altered or even mutated form. An amalgam's experimentation results in a malleable fighter that can always find the edge in combat.
 
Amalgams replace the engineer's utility toolbelt abilities with morph abilities. There are several morph skills, and you can select which ones to fight with in the same manner you select your utility skills. The morph skills command the mercurial mold to shapeshift into different forms, such as a shield, defensive spikes, or even a massive sword.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/4bc45Espec-Video03-021.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/4bc45Espec-Video03-021-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


[b][h3]Become One with the Mold[/h3][/b]

Your elite toolbelt skill is replaced by Evolve. Evolve briefly combines the engineer and mercurial mold into one being, granting a host of benefits. These benefits, however, are unique to each slime. As you select your morph skills, your mercurial mold's composition is altered to also change what happens when you evolve. These compositional shifts, called strains, can vary from granting superspeed and quickness to stunning nearby enemies when you evolve.

Amalgam's utility skills are stances. The mercurial mold can assist you to shift your form, making you as dense as steel or as light as a feather. With the skill Liquid State, you can even melt down into a puddle!


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/fc379gw2-ex6-voe-espec-blog-rev-1920x1080.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/fc379gw2-ex6-voe-espec-blog-rev-1920x1080-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

 
[h1]The Conduit: Channeling the Past[/h1]

Centuries ago, the hero who defeated the fallen god Abaddon met a strange entity imprisoned deep within the Realm of Torment: Razah, a being born of the Mists. Freed by Abaddon's death to seek their own purpose in life, Razah chose to accompany the hero across Tyria, and their boundless curiosity led them to study and master any number of martial and magical disciplines.
  
But Razah's story seemed to have ended with their companion's; no one has seen or heard from them since. They may have returned to the Mists to wander or fallen to the corruption they once feared. They might have learned to mimic human behavior precisely enough to live a hundred lives in obscurity. Or they could have been watching our world, still learning—and waiting for someone like you.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/a069eEspec-Video03-045.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/a069eEspec-Video03-045-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

 
[b][h3]Harness the Mists[/h3][/b]

After the complexity of having two different legends in the form of Saint Victor and Archemorus in [i]Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons®[/i], we wanted to focus on a single legend that offered an equally unique experience. As a denizen born of the Mists, Razah is the first living legend to assist the revenant in their adventures.
 
With the conduit, we wanted to portray the multifaceted nature of Razah's unique link to the Mists. Thus, the elite specialization was designed to have a malleability and flexibility that reflects Razah's ability to transform into any profession. By amplifying the revenant's connection to the Mists, the conduit can tap into a deeper well of power through the legends they choose to channel, further augmenting their existing strengths.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/18f27Espec-Video03-029.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/18f27Espec-Video03-029-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

 
[b][h3]Legendary Affinity[/h3][/b]

As the conduit, you gain the ability to use Cosmic Wisdom, allowing you to further channel the powers of your equipped legend, giving rise to different forms. As an example, using Cosmic Wisdom with Legendary Assassin Stance equipped gives access to Form of the Assassin, granting the conduit bonus power and movement speed, as well as inflicting debilitating conditions on foes you strike. Cosmic Wisdom only lasts for a limited amount of time, but it can be extended through the use of affinity.
 
Affinity is a new resource that represents the strength of your connection to your legend. Affinity can be gained through using any legendary skills that cost energy. Each point of affinity you gain increases the duration of Cosmic Wisdom by a set amount; however, you lose all affinity as you swap legends.
 
Thanks to the power of Razah, conduits gain access to Legendary Entity Stance, bringing with them various skills that harken back to when they wandered Tyria as a hero. Each skill in Legendary Entity Stance has an effect called Resonance, a bonus effect that comes into play if the corresponding legend is equipped in the other slot. For example, Beguiling Haze normally shadowsteps you to your target while performing a quick attack on them. However, when Legendary Assassin Stance is equipped as your second legend, the skill becomes an area-of-effect targeted skill, allowing conduits to shadowstep even without a target, and strikes all enemies in the vicinity.

[h1]Livestream This Friday[/h1]

We hope you enjoyed our elite specialization previews! Let us know on our socials and forums which one you're most excited to play in the upcoming beta on August 20.

Tune in to our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/guildwars2]Twitch channel[/url] this Friday, August 8, at 12:00 p.m. Pacific Time (UTC-7) for more details on the conduit, evoker, and amalgam!
 
For more information about [i]Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity[/i], head over to our [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/news/announcing-guild-wars-2-visions-of-eternity/]official site[/url].


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/bbb7aenUS-gw2-ex6-voe-espec-schedule-1920x1080.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/bbb7aenUS-gw2-ex6-voe-espec-schedule-1920x1080-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Celebrate the Festival of the Four Winds Today!
notes.content:
The Zephyrites have once again set sail for Tyria's shores, while Queen Jennah's Crown Pavilion has opened its gates to visitors from far and wide. That can only mean one thing: the Festival of the Four Winds has returned!
 
Starting today, adventurers of all levels are welcome in the Labyrinthine Cliffs and Divinity's Reach for a season of celebration. The festival ends on Tuesday, August 26, at noon Pacific Time (UTC-7), so don't miss your chance to gather rewards, catch up with the Zephyrites, and make the most of this summer tradition.

[previewyoutube=bwwf6HHzZUo;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[h1]New Rewards[/h1]

This year's festival comes with a fresh breeze of exciting additions, giving players new reasons to return to the cliffs and the pavilion. By completing this year's meta-achievement, you'll unlock the Cloud Cuirass, a striking new chest armor piece designed to reflect the airy elegance of the Zephyrites themselves.
 
Weapon collectors will find plenty to chase this year. The newly introduced Leviathan Bone weapon set makes its debut, featuring fearsome designs carved from mythical leviathan remains. These weapons are earned through the annual meta-achievement and weekly festival achievements.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/497b2gw492.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/497b2gw492-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

 
For those looking for a more nautical vibe, the Seashell Shield, Seashell Focus, and Seashell Staff bring a touch of oceanic flair to your loadout. These one-off weapon skins can be found at the festival's dedicated weapons vendor.
 
If you're a fan of minis, don't miss the Mini Garenhoff Coon Cat—a long-haired fluffball that's ready to follow you across Tyria. This adorable feline is available from the festival vendor.
 
Deft Lahar returns with an expanded inventory of decoration recipes, including six new homestead recipe books that bring beloved Festival of the Four Winds guild hall decorations into your personal homestead. In addition, five brand-new decorations inspired by the spirit of the festival will also be available to add to your homestead or guild hall. The new additions include the Lightning, Sun, and Wind Aspect Crystals, the Zephyrite Display Stand, and even a Siege Turtle Rental Post!


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/93070gw489.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/93070gw489-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Where to Go[/h1]

The Labyrinthine Cliffs can be accessed via Lion's Arch, and the Crown Pavilion can be accessed in Divinity's Reach. Check your in-game mail for an Invitation to the Festival of the Four Winds and double-click the item to teleport instantly to your desired location.

[h1]What to Do[/h1]

When you enter the Labyrinthine Cliffs, you will arrive in a whole new area! This beautiful explorable zone is located on the Tyrian coast. You can navigate this map using the various aspect crystals: wind, sun, and lightning. There are activities all over the map, so keep your eyes peeled!

Experience the thrill of finding treasure with fellow players by participating in the treasure hunt meta-event, or try your hand at one of the races! The Skimmer Slalom and Flying Dolyak adventures will offer you the fun you need in this beachy location. There are also sky crystals all over the map that you can find to complete achievements.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/b0ae7gw476.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/b0ae7gw476-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


If you decide to head to the Crown Pavilion, you will discover many other activities! Join other players in defeating the greatest enemies of Kryta in the Boss Blitz event. But worry not; these are not real beings. They are merely Queen Jennah's watchknight soldiers.

Face off against the strongest individuals in Tyria. Talk to one of the fight managers to join the queue, and you will be transported to a one-versus-one arena—the Queen's Gauntlet! Cheer on your friends or show off your skills to the world.

You can also help the Zephyrites at the Labyrinthine Cliffs seaside by preparing for a treasure hunt! Fill water balloons at the shore and send them up to the upper docks by kite basket.
 
Grab your friends and unlock rewards together! Remember, you have three weeks to experience it all as the festival ends on August 26!  Happy adventuring!

notes.title: Elite Specializations Are Back: Mesmer, Ranger, Guardian
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=nrAOh02l_w8;full][/previewyoutube]

Last week, [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/news/announcing-guild-wars-2-visions-of-eternity/]we announced[/url] our sixth expansion, [i]Guild Wars 2®: Visions of Eternity™[/i], and with that comes the news that elite specializations are back! Over the next three weeks, we'll be providing details on all nine elite specializations through trailers, blogs, and livestreams.
 
This week, we're focusing on the mesmer, ranger, and guardian! Tune in to our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/guildwars2]Twitch channel[/url] this Friday, July 25, at 12:00 p.m. Pacific Time (UTC-7) for a live preview of these elite specializations. You'll also be able to play all of the elite specializations yourself during our beta event from August 20 at 9:00 a.m. Pacific Time (UTC-7) until August 27 at 10:00 p.m. Pacific Time (UTC-7).
 
[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/1c679voe-espec-blog-mesmer.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/1c679voe-espec-blog-mesmer-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]
 
[h1]The Troubadour: Inspiring Storytellers[/h1]
 
Since the firstborn emerged from beneath the boughs of the Pale Tree thirty-six years ago, many sylvari have taken the lesson, "Where life goes, so too, should you," to heart—traversing Tyria, battling their "inner dragons," and finding their place in the time after. These far-flung travelers have seen and done much in such a short time, and some—whether through whim or Wyld Hunt—have taken to regaling Tyrians with tales of recent famous and infamous figures, such as the cunning Dougal Keane, the fearless Almorra Soulkeeper, and even the scathing Scarlet Briar.

Now these sylvari troubadours have returned home from their time abroad to share their craft in good faith and to strengthen the bonds between their people and the rest of the Tyrian Alliance.

Troubadours spin dramatic ballads and tales as their words weave magic and music to raise allies' spirits and demoralize their foes. Their recitals can even be accompanied by illusory instruments for additional effect.

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/63825Espec-video01-001.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/63825Espec-video01-001-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]
 
[b][h3]Build Up to a Crescendo[/h3][/b]

Troubadours are mesmers who seek to support their allies in battle through the power of music and the fantastical tales of Tyrian heroics. Being more aurally focused, troubadours opt to manifest their power by generating musical notes with their abilities rather than visually deceptive clones. These notes are used to extend the duration of their instrumental enchantments, allowing them to command a lasting presence in combat. Once their orchestra is in full swing, troubadours use their keynote skill, Crescendo, to swing the tide of battle with appropriate flair.
 
[b][h3]The Power of Songs and Tales[/h3][/b]

When playing as a troubadour, your shatter skills are replaced by instruments. When an instrument is played, it produces an initial magical effect. Performing with the Reverberating Lute will release waves of sonic energy, damaging enemies. Strumming the Harmonious Harp will create a healing area to provide succor to allies. After an instrument is used, it will continue playing in the background, providing bonuses to the player that can be further augmented through traits.
 
Troubadours use their voices as well as their instruments. They can recite the tale of Queen Jennah protecting Divinity's Reach to grant their allies distortion, or they can invoke the story of Scarlet Briar, emulating her cruelty to debilitate their enemies. Troubadours can become a whole band on their own through the grandmaster trait Call and Response, creating an afterimage of an instrument that repeats its effect!
  
[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/64e2avoe-espec-blog-ranger.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/64e2avoe-espec-blog-ranger-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]
 
[h1]The Galeshot: Masters of the Wind[/h1]

For over a hundred years, the tengu of the Dominion of Winds have kept their gates shut and their arrows trained on the outside world. After minions of Primordus and Jormag threatened to siege the dominion's walls in the last dragonrise, some tengu have emerged to more actively engage in Tyrian affairs and—as a rare honor—offer cultural exchanges at the behest of their royal houses. One such exchange is the honored tradition of the galeshot.

These tengu archers, skilled and oathbound to protect the royal houses, are able to summon the four cardinal winds to form a powerful cyclone bow and deliver swift justice to their foes. As contributing members of the Tyrian Alliance, the tengu now offer tutelage in these skills to willing outsiders who express interest in the galeshot craft.

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/564aeEspec-video01-020.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/564aeEspec-video01-020-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]
 
[b][h3]Wielders of the Cyclone Bow[/h3][/b]

Galeshots are rangers and the premier archers of Tyria. Using their aptitude for nature magic, they can sculpt and command the wind at will. This power is manifested in the Cyclone Bow, a weapon that is capable of long-range devastation. The Cyclone Bow increases in strength as it's used, culminating in a powerful coup de grâce to dispatch your enemies. Learning from nature, galeshots emulate birds in the sky by employing squalls of air. They are swift and graceful to ensure advantageous positioning in battle.
 
[b][h3]Battle With Keen Sight and Unerring Aim[/h3][/b]

Galeshots are able to call upon the Cyclone Bow at will. The Cyclone Bow generates arrows over time. These arrows are a resource used to fuel its skills, such as Supersonic Arrow, a lightning-fast shot of wind that deals heavy damage to enemies it pierces.
 
As you use arrow-consuming skills with the bow, you progress toward enabling its finale, Hawkeye. Hawkeye locks on to your target and nearby enemies, then unleashes a hail of shredding arrows.
 
These archers utilize squalls to control the flow of battle. They can call upon a freezing wind to chill their projectiles, launch themselves with a whirlwind, or even summon a raging tornado. Galeshots can form a closer bond with their avian allies through traits like Flock Together, enhancing bird pets and granting quickness to allies with beast skills.
 
[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/e8b39voe-espec-blog-guardian.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/e8b39voe-espec-blog-guardian-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]
 
[h1]The Luminary: Protectors of the Secret Flame[/h1]
 
In the years following the charr civil war and the scattering of Bangar's Dominion, relations between the four legions have remained steady, bolstered by events after the end of the dragon cycle. With the Flame Legion formally rejoining the legions and the Iron Legion having appointed Smodur's successor, the two legions sought to commemorate the changing times with a joint project. Thus, the luminary was born.

In a shrewd diplomatic play, the two legions have since agreed to share their combined efforts with the Tyrian Alliance and its member races in the spirit of continued collaboration in this new era.

Luminaries bear an enchanted iron brazier that sustains a powerful sacred flame. The bearer can wreathe themselves with this fire and wield a blazing arsenal of weapons against their foes while striking powerful stances mid-fray.

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/d71a4Guardian_09.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/d71a4Guardian_09-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]
 
[b][h3]Harness the Radiant Shroud[/h3][/b]

Luminaries are guardians, stalwart combatants on the battlefield capable of putting out respectable damage or supporting their allies. Their brazier provides energy for the Radiant Shroud, in which they are able to wield various weapons of light and flame to adapt to the situation at hand. Luminaries also have access to stance utility skills, gaining additional tools for offense, defense, crowd control, and mobility.
 
Radiant Shroud is a new take on the shroud mechanic. This shroud has no limiting resource, allowing players to always enter when the shroud is not on cooldown. While in radiant shroud, your weapon skills are replaced with five new skills: a basic attack in the first slot and four radiant weapon skills in the second through fifth slots.
 
[b][h3]Illuminating Weaponry[/h3][/b]
 
Using a radiant weapon skill will equip that weapon while performing an initial attack and then flip over into the weapon's additional skill. The luminary's Grandmaster minor trait, Radiant Armaments, grants a unique passive bonus based on the equipped weapon, which lingers for a bit after exiting shroud.
 
Luminaries looking to maximize their outgoing damage may want to use the hammer right before exiting to take advantage of its bonus damage passive, while those who need to support their allies might prefer to end on staff to gain access to its increased outgoing healing. Players are free to use all four weapons while in shroud, but there is a tradeoff: the recharge time of Radiant Shroud will increase for each weapon used beyond the first.

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
 
We hope you've enjoyed our first of three elite specialization previews. We'll be back next week with details on the next three—and don't forget to tune in to our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/guildwars2]Twitch channel[/url] this Friday, July 25, at 12:00pm Pacific Time (UTC-7) for a closer look at the troubadour, galeshot, and luminary!

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/bbb7aenUS-gw2-ex6-voe-espec-schedule-1920x1080.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/bbb7aenUS-gw2-ex6-voe-espec-schedule-1920x1080-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

Their recitals can even be accompanied by illusory instruments for additional effect.
Troubadours are mesmers who seek to support their allies in battle through the power of music and the fantastical tales of Tyrian heroics.
Being more aurally focused, troubadours opt to manifest their power by generating musical notes with their abilities rather than visually deceptive clones.
These notes are used to extend the duration of their instrumental enchantments, allowing them to command a lasting presence in combat.
Once their orchestra is in full swing, troubadours use their keynote skill, Crescendo, to swing the tide of battle with appropriate flair.

When an instrument is played, it produces an initial magical effect.
Performing with the Reverberating Lute will release waves of sonic energy, damaging enemies.
Strumming the Harmonious Harp will create a healing area to provide succor to allies.
After an instrument is used, it will continue playing in the background, providing bonuses to the player that can be further augmented through traits.
Troubadours use their voices as well as their instruments.

notes.title: Announcing Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity
notes.content:
[p]Today we're thrilled to announce our next expansion, [i]Guild Wars 2®: Visions of Eternity™[/i] and its release date! [i]Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity[/i] launches on October 28, 2025, and, like the previous two expansions, will bring with it a year of story chapters and three major content updates. You can get an overview of what to expect from our sixth expansion on the [url="https://buy.guildwars2.com/visions-of-eternity"]official page[/url], and we'll be sharing tons of additional details between now and launch.

[/p][previewyoutube="JTsj7PnlTgI;full"][/previewyoutube][p]  
[/p][h1]Adventure on an Unknown Island[/h1][p]
Tyria's leaders are anxious about rumors of covert Inquest voyages launched in search of Castora, an island so remote that it's long been thought to be inaccessible—or even nonexistent. The risks involved prevent all but the most tenacious (and perhaps foolhardy) of pursuers from investigating the Inquest's plan.

Your race to discover the Inquest's plot will lead you across two new open-world regions at launch, each filled with magical energies and strange creatures. Two additional maps will open as the story continues over the course of a year. For [i]Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity[/i], we'll be releasing story chapters differently than we've done for the previous two expansions. To read about this and other insights, see our [url="https://www.guildwars2.com/news/from-the-wilds-to-whats-next"][i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds™[/i][/url][url="https://www.guildwars2.com/news/from-the-wilds-to-whats-next"] retrospective blog[/url] from last week.


[img src="//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/5fa16Castora-tree-590x332.jpg"][/img]
  
[/p][h1]Expansion Features[/h1][p]
[/p][h3]New Elite Specializations[/h3][p] 
Elite specializations are back! Influences from members of the Tyrian Alliance bring new ways to play each of our nine professions. In [i]Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity[/i], you'll experience new trait lines, profession mechanics, and healing, utility, and elite skills, adding many new ways to play your characters.
 
From August 20 to 27, we're holding an in-game preview week for you to beta test all of the elite specializations. When that preview arrives, we'll ask for your feedback to help us take each elite specialization through the polish phase and into launch. All players with a [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] account in good standing may participate in the preview.
 
We'll be back next week to kick off a series of blogs and livestreams to talk about the elite specializations in great detail. Stay tuned!


[img src="//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/b19b9EspecMinBarTro-590x332.jpg"][/img]
 
[h3]Skimmer Mastery[/h3]
In [i]Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity[/i], the skimmer mount will be featured with new and updated mechanics. Hover, dive, and soar faster than ever before as you explore the dangerous and beautiful environments of Castora!
 
[h3]Raids and Combat[/h3]
In 2026, raids and strikes will be unified under the same structure, improving access for new players and streamlining rewards. We're also investing in systems that help facilitate group content, which we'll talk about more in the future.
 
Two new raid encounters (including challenge modes and a legendary mode) will be added in the major updates to [i]Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity[/i] next year. In addition, a new Convergence and fractal with challenge mode will also release in the final expansion update next year, giving players lots of obstacles to tackle and overcome!


[img src="//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/6aa63VoECombat-590x332.jpg"][/img]

[h3]Legendary Treasures[/h3]

Over the course of the expansion and its subsequent content updates, players can pursue six new legendary items: three new weapons, a ring, an accessory, and the long-requested aquabreather!

[h3]New Homestead[/h3]

Players who own both [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i] and [i]Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity[/i] will get to unlock a whole new homestead map! You'll also be able to save your decoration layout and freely swap between the Janthiri and Castoran maps with the new layouts feature. We'll share more information about the new homestead and layouts in the coming months.   

[h3]Other Rewards[/h3]

The Wizard's Vault will continue to offer new seasonal rewards for players to earn as they play through the expansion. New relics will bring players more options for their builds and combat capabilities. And, of course, you'll also be able to earn new armor, weapons, recipes, emotes, and more!

[img src="//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/d9af5gw2-ex6-voe-3p-pre-purchase-1920x1080-590x332.jpg"][/img]

[h1]Prepurchase Bonuses Available Now[/h1]

Prepurchasing any edition of [i]Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity[/i] before the expansion launches at approximately 9:00 a.m. Pacific Time (UTC-7) on October 28, 2025, comes with three rewards: the exclusive Plumed Commodore's Hat helm skin, the exclusive "Eternal Alchemist" title, and a box with your choice of one Chromatic Resin weapon skin.

Visit the [url="https://buy.guildwars2.com/visions-of-eternity"]official store page[/url] for full details on the Standard, Deluxe, and Ultimate editions. You can prepurchase the expansion through the official store or from the in-game store, Steam, EGS, or official retailers.

[h1]Fashion Forward[/h1]

We have one final feature that will launch in one of the major updates to [i]Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity[/i] next year and will be available to all players regardless of expansion ownership: fashion templates!

Fashion templates function similarly to build and equipment templates, allowing players to save a template of the aesthetic features for their armor, back item, outfits, and dyes. We’ll share more information here in the future about fashion templates—and all the other features coming with [i]Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity[/i]!*
 
You can read more details about the full contents of [i]Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity[/i] on the [url="https://buy.guildwars2.com/visions-of-eternity"]product page[/url]. It'll be a busy summer as we prepare to set sail for Castora, so stay tuned for more information!

[i]*This post was amended on July 15 with a corrected list of features managed by fashion templates.[/i]

notes.title: From the Wilds to What's Next
notes.content:
Hey, [i]Guild Wars[/i] community,

With the final content update for [i]Guild Wars 2®: Janthir Wilds™[/i] now live, we've officially wrapped our fifth expansion, which is the second built under the annual release model we introduced in early 2023.

[i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i] tested how we tell stories, evolve systems, and deliver meaningful updates on a faster, more consistent schedule. Some things landed well. Others, not as much.

Just [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/en-gb/news/secrets-of-the-obscure-looking-back-and-forward/]like we did[/url] after [i]Guild Wars 2: Secrets of the Obscure™[/i], we've been listening to your feedback and acting on it. In this blog, we'll share how those lessons are shaping our next expansion and the changes you can expect to see. This will give you helpful context as we unveil our next expansion next week.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/13af1EX5_Launch_Key_Art-copy.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/13af1EX5_Launch_Key_Art-copy-590x354.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Charting Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds's Legacy[/h1]

Over the past nine months, [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i] brought a wide range of new experiences to Tyria.

Across nineteen story chapters and four new open-world maps, the narrative explored the aftermath of the Elder Dragon era through a more grounded and political lens. Your choices helped shape the balance of power in a world learning to live without that existential threat and uncovered ancient secrets best left buried.

We brought spears to land combat—our first new terrestrial weapon type since the game's launch—along with a new set of relics that deepened build crafting and expanded playstyle customization.

Our endgame offerings grew as well. You took on the game's first new raid in over five years, complete with challenge and legendary modes. We also introduced a new Convergence encounter and a fractal dungeon with its own challenge mode, adding more variety and goals for PvE-focused players.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/8d13dHomestead_concept.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/8d13dHomestead_concept-590x331.jpg[/img][/url]


[i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i] also marked the arrival of Homesteads, a major feature that brought player housing to the game. That was paired with a rework of the decoration system, updates to the warclaw mount, two new legendaries, tons of new armor and weapon sets, Wizard's Vault refreshes, and a long list of quality-of-life upgrades.

In PvP, we built something new with your help. The Push game mode began as a prototype and evolved through multiple public betas, shaped directly by player feedback. Co-developing a competitive mode in a live environment is rare, and we're proud of what it represents. The final version launches later this summer, and we hope it sets a precedent for future community-driven efforts.

[i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i] delivered a lot in a short amount of time. That momentum was only possible because of your passion, creativity, and honest feedback.

[h1]Finding the Right Rhythm[/h1]

[i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i] launched in August of last year, followed by three quarterly updates. After the first of those updates arrived in November 2024, we heard consistent feedback from the community: the additional story content felt too short, and the lack of a new open-world map made the update feel noticeably light. Similar reactions to story scope followed the second and third releases, signaling that the pacing and structure of these releases could better align with your expectations.

For our next expansion, we're refining that structure to give each update more depth and impact. The first quarterly release after the expansion's launch will not include new story or map content. Instead, it will focus on updates to core systems and longstanding features. This approach gives us the space to revisit foundational elements of the game—improvements that support the long-term health of [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] and reflect the design philosophy outlined in the "Building Smarter, Not Bigger" section below.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/a55e7JanthirWilds_Fjord.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/a55e7JanthirWilds_Fjord-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


By focusing on story and map development in the second and third quarterly updates, we're able to make those releases more robust and satisfying. Each will introduce a larger, more content-rich map and a longer, more fully developed story than what players saw in the equivalent [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i] updates. While the total amount of story content across the expansion is increasing modestly, the bigger benefit is how much more meaningful each individual release will feel, along with the scope improvements to the open-world maps.

This approach allows for more complete and satisfying story arcs, and it results in a net increase in total content delivered over the course of the expansion.

[h1]Building Smarter, Not Bigger[/h1]

One of our biggest priorities right now (and likely for years to come) is untangling years of accumulated system complexity. That means streamlining overlapping features, reducing technical debt, and reinforcing what makes [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] shine. This complexity doesn't just slow us down behind the scenes. It also makes onboarding harder for new and returning players, even in areas designed for seasoned adventurers like endgame PvE.

Over the past two expansions, we've shifted away from stacking new systems on top of old ones. Instead, we're focusing on sustainable upgrades to the game's foundation.

Features like the Wizard's Vault didn't just offer something new; they replaced daily achievements and login rewards with a streamlined, modern alternative. Weaponmaster Training and relics were built to expand existing build systems. Homesteads and the decoration system overhaul also improved guild halls.  We also updated core mount systems during both expansions, with refinements to the skyscale in [i]Guild Wars 2: Secrets of the Obscure[/i] and improvements to the warclaw in [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i]. Each change was designed to strengthen features you already use and love.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/533b2HomesteadInterior2.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/533b2HomesteadInterior2-590x284.jpg[/img][/url]


Support for newly introduced features doesn't end at launch. Since the Homesteads feature debuted, we've continued to expand and refine the system with new decorations and quality-of-life improvements, including an increase to the overall decoration cap in the final [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i] release, "Absolution." In our upcoming July 15 release, we're doubling the decoration area limit from 200 to 400. This directly addresses one of the most common requests we've heard from you. You can also expect to see continued support for the Homesteads feature in our next expansion as we build on this foundation.

These kinds of changes may not always grab headlines, but they make the game easier to understand, easier to maintain, and more enjoyable to play. Just as importantly, they reflect what many of you have asked us to do: focus less on introducing entirely new systems and more on refining and modernizing what we already have. That's a direction we believe in, and one we're proud to continue as we build the next chapter of [i]Guild Wars 2[/i].

[h1]New Tricks for Every Trade[/h1]

Over the past two expansions, we've expanded options for combat by giving you more tools to customize your builds and play your way. [i]Guild Wars 2: Secrets of the Obscure[/i] introduced new weapon proficiencies for every profession and separated relics from runes to deepen build crafting. The addition of Weaponmaster Training was also a major step forward in allowing players to freely mix and match elite specialization weapons across builds, and the addition of land spears offered a new weapon for every profession to use. 

With our next expansion, we're taking the next step. Elite specializations are making a return, this time designed to work together with the flexible build crafting system we've been refining over the past few years. However, these new specializations won't come with dedicated weapons. Instead, each one introduces unique profession mechanics, a new trait line, utility skills, an elite skill, a healing skill, and distinct playstyles without locking you into a specific weapon or equipment loadout.

These new specializations are designed to feel fresh, fun, and unique to [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] while building on the systems you already know and love. We'll have much more to share soon.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/c311ajw-qr1-wallpaper.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/c311ajw-qr1-wallpaper-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Challenging the Challengers[/h1]

The launch of the Mount Balrior raid wasn't just a development milestone for us—with both legendary and challenge modes, it was a long-awaited return for players eager to take on high-end group content. It marked a turning point in our ongoing effort to revitalize endgame PvE.

Over the past few years, we've focused on delivering meaningful, replayable encounters across both raids and Strike Missions. Most recently, we returned to our encounter design roots with Kinfall, a new fractal designed in direct response to player feedback. With Kinfall, we stepped back from the raid-like complexity of recent fractals and focused instead on creating a streamlined, repeatable experience that captures the feel of early favorites. The challenge mode arrived a few weeks later, offering both accessibility and satisfying difficulty.

Looking ahead, we'll continue to expand endgame content—including new encounters complete with challenge and legendary modes. But just as important as adding more is making that content better, more approachable, and more rewarding to return to.

In the first quarterly release of our next expansion, that means unifying raids and Strike Missions into a more consistent structure, improving onboarding for newer players, reworking parts of the UI, streamlining rewards, and investing in systems that help group content feel easier to step into and more meaningful to stick with.

We want [i]Guild Wars 2[/i]'s endgame to be something anyone can grow into, whether you're joining your first organized group or aiming to master every challenge we throw your way.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/155abenUS-gw2-ex5-jw-qr3-studio-update-roadmap-1920x1080.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/155abenUS-gw2-ex5-jw-qr3-studio-update-roadmap-1920x1080-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]What Comes Next[/h1]

[i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i] helped us learn where to push harder, where to simplify, and how to better listen to the needs of our players. Your feedback didn't just resonate with us; it reshaped how we're thinking about the game and how we're building what's coming next.

Mark your calendar—you'll get your first look at the next expansion on July 15. Thanks again for your passion, your support, and your belief in this world—and in the people who bring it to life.

See you next week,

Josh Davis, Game Director
 
P.S. Thanks for reading this far. Here's another teaser for your troubles.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/a25a5gw2-recap-jw-1920x1080.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/a25a5gw2-recap-jw-1920x1080-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Janthir Wilds Concludes With "Absolution" Release Today!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=0boXkTbLZ8o;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
[h1]"Absolution" Is Live[/h1]

"Absolution," the third and final major content update for [i]Guild Wars 2®: Janthir Wilds™[/i], has arrived. This update brings the concluding chapters of the story, a brand-new map to explore, feature improvements, new content and rewards, and a few unexpected twists to keep players on their toes. We've also added a unique legendary backpack that doubles as a glider! We're going to cover the major features of this release in this blog, but for all of the details, check out the [url=https://en-forum.guildwars2.com/topic/158408-game-update-notes-june-3-2025/]full release notes[/url] on our forums.

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/75504bavanisos-blog.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/75504bavanisos-blog-590x337.jpg[/img][/url]
 
[h1]What's New?[/h1]

In our latest [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/news/studio-update-absolution-launches-june-3]studio update blog[/url], we shared what's ahead for [i]Guild Wars 2[/i], including a closer look at upcoming content and our ongoing goals for long-term feature support. We also released a companion blog focused on the [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/news/quality-of-life-improvements-in-janthir-wilds-absolution]quality-of-life improvements[/url] we've made that aim to enhance your everyday experience in Tyria. There's much more to come in "Absolution," however, and here are the highlights from this update:
 
[list][*]New map: [url=https://youtu.be/g0RigY5qOGk]Bava Nisos[/url][/*]
[*]New story chapters[/*]
[*]New fractal: Kinfall (with challenge mode on June 24)[/*]
[*]Convergences update: new boss, Ura, and challenge mode for private squads[/*]
[*]Legendary backpack[/*]
[*]QoL improvements to inventory management, rift essences, research notes, and more![/*]
[*]New homestead decorations and decoration cap increase![/*]
[*]Many new rewards, including minis, armor, weapons, and more[/*][/list]
 
[previewyoutube=KyBk3LnuBXQ;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[h1]Your New Best Friend Is a Legendary Backpack[/h1]
 
An immortal shadowy demonic presence from the Mists, Orrax is here to be your new best friend! Go on adventures! Glide around! Find some tasty snacks! Make a bargain for your immortal soul! Swish a fancy new tail that you may not have had a few moments before! Orrax will join you on all of your adventures—just as soon as you finish letting it manifest through you into Tyria.

Like previous legendary backpacks, crafting Orrax Manifested will unlock a matching glider as well. However, this time, Orrax is not content simply staying on your back and manifests directly to better help you conquer the skies of this fascinating world.

Talk to Jorvik Jorundsson in Mantle's Arrival in Bava Nisos after completing the story of "Absolution" to begin the legendary collection.

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/b12ccLegendary-BP-01.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/b12ccLegendary-BP-01-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]
 
[h1]Wizard's Vault Seasonal Refresh[/h1]

The Astral Ward's magic stirs once again, and the Wizard's Vault unveils a new collection of treasures for the worthy. Whether you're defending Tyria's farthest reaches or honing your legend within the Mists, these rewards are steeped in both style and power.

Embrace the strength and nobility of the Ward Knight's cape, coat, helm, and leggings, armor forged for the bravest of Tyria's defenders that blends ceremonial elegance with battlefield grit. Or arm yourself with the Stone-Growth weapons petrified by the passage of countless years!

Ride in arcane style with the Enchanted Roller Beetle Skin, adding a magical gleam to your travels. Don't forget to give it a spin on the new racetrack in Southsun Cove!

[previewyoutube=9OICnDjv72M;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[h1]Twitch Drops[/h1]

Starting June 3, you can earn exciting  [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/twitch-drops/]Twitch Drops[/url] just by watching your favorite  [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] streamers! Watch a total of five hours between 9:00 a.m. Pacific Time (UTC-7) March 11 and 11:59 p.m. Pacific Time (UTC-7) June 8 to unlock all available rewards.

Here's what you can earn:

[list][*]One Hour: Tradesman's Package[/*]
[*]Two Hours: Bloodstone Ascender[/*]
[*]Four Hours: Mini Bloodstone Rock[/*]
[*]Six Hours: Bloodstone Glider[/*][/list]

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/83afbenUS-gw2-ex5-jw-qr3-twitch-drops-reminder-1920x1080.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/83afbenUS-gw2-ex5-jw-qr3-twitch-drops-reminder-1920x1080-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds Vinyl Soundtrack[/h1]
 
Immerse yourself in the rich soundscape of [i]Guild Wars 2[/i]' s fifth expansion with the official soundtrack of [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i]. Featuring 27 tracks composed by Maclaine Diemer, Bryan Atkinson, and others, this collection captures the spirit of a land both wild and storied.
 
The soundtrack brings to life the sweeping coastlines, ancient ruins, and deep-rooted mysteries of the Janthir isles. With each track, you'll hear the tension between nature and civilization, tradition and transformation.
 
Hear songs from this update adding new layers to the musical journey across the isles. Whether you're exploring tranquil lowlands or braving conflict alongside the lowland kodan, these themes help shape every step of your adventure.
 
You can  [url=https://materia.store/products/guild-wars-2-janthir-wilds-2xlp]preorder the [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i] vinyl soundtrack[/url] today. 

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/c9925GW2-Janthir-Wilds_Social.png][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/c9925GW2-Janthir-Wilds_Social-590x332.png[/img][/url]
 
[h1]Fun All Summer Long[/h1]

While "Absolution" marks the conclusion of the [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i] story arc, the adventure in Tyria is far from over. A full slate of events is on the horizon while we prepare to share more about what is next for [i]Guild Wars 2[/i].
 
The celebration kicks off on June 17 with the return of Dragon Bash, bringing festive chaos and brawling fun to the streets of Hoelbrak. Just a few days later, on June 23, challenge seekers can dive into the new Kinfall fractal's challenge mode.
 
In July, players can look forward to the announcement of our next expansion and bonus events! The Return to Secrets of the Obscure event runs from July 15 to July 29, offering a chance to relive key moments and earn valuable rewards. Then it's off to the Mists from July 22 to July 29 with the WvW Rush bonus event!
 
As summer rolls on, Festival of the Four Winds returns from August 5 to August 26, inviting players to relax, compete, and revisit one of Tyria's most beloved seasonal events. Don't forget to bookmark our [url=https://en-forum.guildwars2.com/events/]handy event calendar[/url] to keep tabs on what's happening in the game!

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/155abenUS-gw2-ex5-jw-qr3-studio-update-roadmap-1920x1080.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/155abenUS-gw2-ex5-jw-qr3-studio-update-roadmap-1920x1080-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3][b]June[/b][/h3]

Stay tuned for news about our next expansion for [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] this summer. We look forward to joining you on your adventure in Bava Nisos!
