notes.title: Quality-of-Life Improvements in Janthir Wilds: "Absolution"
notes.content:
Salutations, Tyrians. My name is Gerard Ledda, and I am a game designer here at ArenaNet. We're always listening to your feedback, and we've been hard at work on some game updates that you've been asking for. Today, I'm here with the inside scoop on some quality-of-life updates that are coming in next week's [i]Guild Wars 2®: Janthir Wilds™[/i] release, [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/news/studio-update-absolution-launches-june-3/]"Absolution."[/url] These changes are designed to alleviate pain points, add convenience, and—most importantly—free up precious inventory space!

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/9c0edQoLMiyrna-blog.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/9c0edQoLMiyrna-blog-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Traveling Light with the Wizard's Portal Tome[/h1]

The Wizard's Portal Tome is a new item that will store many of the teleportation devices you've earned in game, condensing more than 30 items into a single inventory slot! This tome will work much like the Living World season portal tomes, giving you a list of available destinations to choose from.
 
When "Absolution" releases on June 3, you can visit Astral Ward Medic Miyrna either in Bloodcoast Ward in Lion's Arch or in the new map, Bava Nisos, to pick up a new side story achievement, Work Hard for Now. Completing that side story will reward you with the Wizard's Portal Tome, and the Teleportation Gizmos Collector collection will track the teleportation devices that you've earned. Then, just bring the Wizard's Portal Tome wherever you go, and you can free up all that inventory space!

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/1af39QoLGharr-blog.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/1af39QoLGharr-blog-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Gobble Your Way to More Inventory Space[/h1]

Over the years, we've added many portable exchangers—commonly called "gobblers"—to the game that allow players to convert items and currency to more valuable materials. Over time, these gobblers have become so plentiful that they themselves clog up inventory space. The Wizard's Gobbler is our solution to this problem, allowing you access to multiple exchange items without having to fumble with them individually.

Like the Wizard's Portal Tome, a collection will track over 20 portable exchanger and gobbler items as you unlock them and offer their functionality in a single item. Visiting Lion's Arch will retroactively update your progress if you have the item in your inventory, have completed the respective achievement, or have met other conditions. This will determine which options you can access when using the Wizard's Gobbler. All [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] players can access the Wizard's Gobbler by heading to Hooligan's Route in Lion's Arch and purchasing it from the charr vendor Gharr Leadclaw.

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/5e726QoLAdam-Blog.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/5e726QoLAdam-Blog-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Rift Essence Converting to Wallet Currency[/h1]

We've heard that your bag and bank slots are overflowing with rift essence, and we've got a solution coming next week!

Fine, masterwork, and rare rift essence can be converted into a wallet currency beginning June 3. You'll be able to convert the essence yourself by consuming it or by visiting Rift Researcher Adam at Moon Camp Covert in Lowland Shore or the Rift Hunter Lounge in the Wizard's Tower. He will be able to mass convert your essence into a wallet currency for free. Recipes, vendor costs, and rewards of rift essence will all be updated to reflect this change.

[h1]Easier Acquisition of Research Notes[/h1]

We've also heard your feedback about the challenge of acquiring research notes. After the next update, all crafting disciplines will have access to a new crafting recipe called Peer Reviewed Research. This item does not have a crafting rating requirement, so even novices can make it. When crafted, it grants 150 research notes!

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/a2052QoLMiyrna2-blog.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/a2052QoLMiyrna2-blog-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Faction Provisioner Purchase Limits[/h1]

We'll be adjusting the purchase limits of provisioner tokens from faction provisioners in Central Tyria and Heart of Maguuma from one purchase a day per tab to seven purchases a week per tab. You'll be able to buy the same number of items, but in one trip instead of seven!

[h1]Commander's Choice Chest Improvements[/h1] 

During your adventures, you might have accumulated a surplus of Hero's Choice Chests, and when you finally decide which item to select from them, you were faced with a difficult choice. You could open them one at a time through a time-consuming series of clicks, or you could use a bulk exchange vendor but lose out on some of the valuable loot inside.

With the release of "Absolution," you can trade Hero's Choice Chests and karma to the respective exchange vendors in Dragon's Stand, Eye of the North, Arborstone, the Wizard's Tower (requires Wayfinder Mastery), or Lowland Shore. You'll then receive the guaranteed item in addition to a new Commander's Choice Chest, which allows bulk selection of your choice of items. This functions like the Janthiri Renown Chests and Mistburned Renown Chests.

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/e8fc6QoLHomestead-blog.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/e8fc6QoLHomestead-blog-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Homesteads Decoration Limit Increase[/h1]

Finally, players will be able to double the decoration cap in their homestead from 1,000 to 2,000 after "Absolution" is live next week! Deft Lahar will sell decoration limit increase services to raise the cap by 500, and players can train the Grandmaster Handiworker Crafting tier for another 500.

Deft Lahar will also have new home instance nodes in his inventory, allowing players to purchase new gathering nodes for their homesteads or home instances.

"Absolution" is just around the corner, and we can't wait for you to experience these new quality-of-life updates. See you in Tyria!

notes.title: Studio Update: "Absolution" Launches June 3
notes.content:
Greetings, Tyrians! 

The final chapter of [i]Guild Wars 2®: Janthir Wilds™[/i] arrives on June 3 with "Absolution," a climactic update that plunges deep into the haunted heart of mursaat history. Journey into the ruins of Bava Nisos and  uncover the truth behind the rift that still threatens Tyria.

Alongside this epic conclusion, "Absolution" also brings a new fractal, a legendary backpiece, homestead upgrades, a suite of quality-of-life changes, relics, goodies in the Wizard's Vault, and the debut of challenge mode for Convergence: Mount Balrior, along with a Twitch Drops event to celebrate the release. Let's take a look at what's coming next for [i]Guild Wars 2[/i].

[previewyoutube=0boXkTbLZ8o;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds—"Absolution"[/h1]

When Mabon fell to the Kryptis, an ancient ward cast over the city of Bava Nisos evaporated. All its secrets were free to fester—all its ghosts danced back to life.

At the start of [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i], the commander was sent on a mission of diplomacy to befriend the lowland kodan of the Janthir region. But just as we settled into the calming rituals of the delta lifestyle, a darker threat emerged from the shadows. Titans had somehow been released into Tyria once again, and the commander, with the aid of allies old and new, navigated the perilous reaches of Janthir to defeat these otherworldly creatures. Victory was just within reach, too, before Ura revealed with her dying breath that the door that she and her kin used to breach our realm remained wide open.

In the second update for [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i], "Repentance," we chased the echo of an old acquaintance through the ruins of his people's demise as we searched for this open Mists gate. Now, in the finale of [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i], we will reach the core of the titan crisis once and for all.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/ec417gw295.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/ec417gw295-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Bava Nisos[/h1] 

Each of the three survey teams that you helped comb through Mistburned Barrens completed their research and have come to the same conclusion: something vile awaits us within the depths of Bava Nisos. When a path into the city proper is finally revealed at the start of "Absolution," our final descent begins.

Once a monument to mursaat victory, Bava Nisos was built into the side of a great mountain—its sprawling halls and twisting passages branch in every direction. However, the once-opulent city is now crumbling with decay. When the Door of Komalie was opened and titans spilled out into Tyria, Bava Nisos was sieged by a bloody battle that took down one of Tyria's most powerful societies. Most of the living mursaat and attacking titans were slaughtered. But despite their defeat and the city's abandonment, menacing magic still lingers inside of Bava Nisos. Left alone for almost three hundred years, this magic has mutated and warped with time.

As the grand finale of the [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i] experience, Bava Nisos contains a climactic map-wide meta-event. You'll be working alongside factions supporting the Tyrian Alliance—such as Councillor Ludo from Rata Sum and a spirited guest from Divinity's Reach's most elusive social club—to fight your way to the Mists gate at the city's heart. The meta contains three main lanes that players can participate in, where you'll face various obstacles and threats as you navigate the surreal landscape.

What could possibly await you inside?


[h1]New Challenges Await[/h1]

The battle for Mount Balrior is about to get even more intense. In "Absolution," we're adding the third and final Convergences boss encounter as Ura, the titan imperatrix known as the Steamshrieker, at last makes her appearance. This godspawn commands the scalding steam and choking geysers of the mountain, making her unending wrath truly something to be feared. If you've fought Ura before, this encounter introduces some new mechanics to make this a fresh twist on the Mount Balrior experience!

And for those seeking an even greater test of skill, we're also introducing challenge mode for Mount Balrior Convergences, offering greater difficulty, sharper coordination checks, and even more rewarding spoils for those who triumph.

Our newest fractal dungeon, Kinfall, also arrives on June 3. Step into the roles of a small band of lowland kodan as they defend their homeland during the Icebrood invasion of northern Tyria…and as they hear the whispers of the legendary dragon Jormag. In response to player feedback, with Kinfall we've intentionally stepped back from the raid-like complexity of more recent fractals in favor of a streamlined and repeatable experience reminiscent of some of our earlier fractals. The challenge mode for Kinfall will release three weeks later, in our June 24 game update.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/72c6eKinfallFractal.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/72c6eKinfallFractal-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Home Improvement[/h1]

In "Absolution," we're doubling the homestead decoration cap to 2,000, giving builders and dreamers the space they've been craving. Players can train the new Grandmaster Handiworker Crafting tier to increase the decoration limit by 500, and Deft Lahar will sell decoration limit increases to raise the cap by an additional 500. This release also introduces new decorations and adds two new resource nodes to Deft Lahar's inventory.

But we're not stopping at structural upgrades; we're elevating the vibes as well. On June 3, the Black Lion Trading Company will debut a brand-new customization option that lets you change the appearance of your homestead's sky. First up is a dazzling aurora borealis display that turns Hearth's Glow into a northern dreamscape. Later this year, you'll also be able to personalize the entrance to your homestead with skins for your conjured doorway. 

Look forward to even more updates to homesteads in our next expansion later this year. Homesteads are beginning to rival fashion wars for the most expressive corner of Tyria!


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/33211Shimmering_Aurora_Screenshot_02.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/33211Shimmering_Aurora_Screenshot_02-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]

We've got a hefty round of quality-of-life updates coming your way in "Absolution." From the Wizard's Portal Tome to hold your collection of portal scrolls to the endlessly efficient Wizard's Gobbler, this update is full of small changes that make a big difference (and free up some much-needed inventory space)! We'll dive into all the details in a dedicated blog later this week. Stay tuned!

[h1]Summer Schedule[/h1]

While "Absolution" marks the end of the [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i] story arc, there's still plenty to look forward to in the months ahead while you await this summer's news of our next expansion.  

Here's a look at what's coming up on the horizon:

[list][*][b]July (TBA)[/b]—Expansion Announcement[/*]
[*][b]July 15–July 29[/b]—Return to [i]Secrets of the Obscure[/i] Event[/*]
[*][b]July 22–July 29[/b]—WvW Rush Bonus Event[/*][/list]

[h3][b]August[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]August 5–August 12[/b]—PvP Push Beta Event 3[/*]
[*][b]August 5–August 26[/b]—Festival of the Four Winds[/*][/list]


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/155abenUS-gw2-ex5-jw-qr3-studio-update-roadmap-1920x1080.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/155abenUS-gw2-ex5-jw-qr3-studio-update-roadmap-1920x1080-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


Stay tuned to our channels throughout this week and next as we share a deeper look at what's coming with "Absolution." As always, thank you for being part of this journey with us. 
—The Guild Wars 2 Team

notes.title: Push PvP Game Mode Development Update and Beta Event
notes.content:
[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/f61begw002.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/f61begw002-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

Greetings, Tyrians!

We're back with an update on Push, the fast-paced 5v5 PvP game mode first revealed alongside [i]Guild Wars 2®: Janthir Wilds™[/i]. In Push, teams battle for control of a moving objective, working to escort it into the enemy base while fending off their opponents' efforts to do the same. It's a tug-of-war where map control, timing, and team coordination are the keys to victory. Push draws inspiration from "payload" or "escort"  modes found in many other competitive games. If you missed the original announcement or want a refresher on how the mode came to be, check out our [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/news/introducing-push-a-new-pvp-game-mode/]first Push blog[/url] from last year.

Back in September, we hosted the first live beta for Push, featuring a rough prototype of the mode's mechanics on a placeholder map. While the visuals and UI were in the early stages of development, the goal was to gauge community interest—and the response exceeded our expectations. Your enthusiasm and feedback gave us the confidence to move forward and invest in building Push into a fully realized game mode.

We've made some updates and will be running another live beta event beginning on Tuesday, May 20 at noon Pacific Time (UTC-7) and running until May 27 at noon Pacific Time (UTC-7). We're also running a PvP Rush bonus event at the same time, so you can collect some extra rewards while you help us test the Push mode!

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/f8680enUS-gw2-ex5-jw-pvp-push-mode-intro-update-2-1920x1080.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/f8680enUS-gw2-ex5-jw-pvp-push-mode-intro-update-2-1920x1080-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Pushing Out Some Changes[/h1]

We have some significant updates prepared for the next beta event that we'd like to share with you. First, we have a first iteration of the new map for the Push mode. We received a lot of positive feedback on the layout of the placeholder map from the initial beta, so we've done our best to maintain the general footprint of the old map in the new one—just with a fresh coat of paint and a new theme.

Just like in the first beta, the new map still has a good amount of "gray box" art, but we're comfortable with the broad layout and want to start getting feedback on more specifics. The Super Adventure Box's Angry Cloud will be taking a well-earned leave from the game mode, and in its place is a slick jade tech hovercart. This hovercraft objective will display a colored highlight indicating which team has control, for easy readability.

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/a0e08gw023.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/a0e08gw023-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

We've also made an update to the center secondary objective. During the first beta, this was a channeled objective that would prevent the enemy team from contesting the capture point for a period of time. The feedback around this objective was generally negative, as there wasn't any counterplay to the negative effect once it was applied. We do like the idea of the center objective creating pressure on the capture point for the enemy team, but we want to do it in a more interactive way.

For the upcoming beta, we'll be utilizing mechanics from the Skyhammer conquest map. When players successfully channel the center objective, three skyhammer cannon shots will fire on the capture point. These skyhammer shots can be dodged with proper timing, but failing to do so will result in massive damage and a knockdown effect. Internally, we've been playing with the new center objective mechanic, and it certainly feels like a step in the right direction, so we're excited to see what the community thinks about it.

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/93edepushUI2.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/93edepushUI2-590x97.jpg[/img][/url]


The last main update for the next beta is a first-version implementation of what will eventually become the official scoreboard UI for the game mode. During the first beta, the map didn't do a great job of representing who was ahead, especially in close games. The new UI gives players an easy view of the current relative position of the capture point along its path in addition to displaying each team's best push as a percentage of the path traveled.

[h1]Looking for Feedback[/h1]

During the beta event, the Push mode will replace the ranked queue with the same mini-season rewards. You'll also be able to access the Push mode in custom arena maps and, as we mentioned above, we have a PvP Rush event happening at the same time for extra incentive to get into the action!

Whether it's your first look at Push or you're a battle-scarred veteran, we want to hear from you. Head over to our [url=https://en-forum.guildwars2.com/topic/158156-feedback-thread-push-pvp-game-mode-beta/]Push feedback forum thread[/url] and let us know what you think. We're specifically interested in feedback regarding the changes we've made, but we'd love broader feedback on the Push game mode in general as well. Our goal throughout this beta process is to keep the community involved to make sure that we're making the best possible version of Push that we can.

We'll see you in the Mists!


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/e6c3egw011.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/e6c3egw011-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Celebrating 20 Years of Guild Wars
notes.content:
Twenty years ago this month, ArenaNet launched the first [i]Guild Wars®[/i] campaign, which would eventually be called [i]Prophecies™[/i]. Since then, it's been our real joy to welcome many millions of players from all over the world to Tyria—first in the original [i]Guild Wars[/i], and more recently here in [i]Guild Wars 2®[/i].

We're excited to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the [i]Guild Wars[/i] universe this month. [i]Guild Wars[/i] retrospective items are back in the [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] Gem Store, the Anniversary Celebration festival kicks off in the original [i]Guild Wars[/i] today with new and newly available items, and there's a sale on [i]Guild Wars[/i] game editions.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/3e849GardenOfSeborhin02.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/3e849GardenOfSeborhin02-590x369.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Guild Wars Homage Items Return in Guild Wars 2[/h1]

Select [i]Guild Wars[/i] retrospective items are returning to the [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] Gem Store at a 20% discount! Pick up classic looks like Gwen's Attire or the Primeval Dervish Outfit and weapon skins like the Storm Bow Skin, Bone Dragon Staff Skin, and Peacock Scepter Skin. These items will be available until April 29.

In addition to the cosmetics available from the Black Lion Trading Company, remember that a number of craftable and earnable weapons based on the original [i]Guild Wars[/i] are always available, like the [url=https://wiki.guildwars2.com/wiki/Destroyer_weapons]Destroyer[/url] and [url=https://wiki.guildwars2.com/wiki/Tengu_Echo_weapons]Tengu[/url] weapon sets, unique weapons like Fellblade and Razorstone, and of course the iconic Sunspear (as both a staff and a spear)—just to name a few!


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/b6e86gw630.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/b6e86gw630-590x248.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Updated Rewards in Guild Wars[/h1]

An update today makes rewards newly available in the original [i]Guild Wars[/i]. Specifically, many items that were previously available only as promotional exclusives have been reissued. Promotional weapons—including those from preorders, like the iconic Sunspear, and regional launches—have been made into rare-quality drops from high-level enemies in the world. A selection of previously limited-release minis can also now be acquired in nontradeable form by completing quests for Merrise, Sworn to Seas in Embark Beach.

We're also excited to announce that new weapon upgrades for main-hand weapons have been added to the game as rare drops. These "of the [Profession]" modifiers will boost the level of the named profession's primary attribute to as much as 5 (unless you already have a higher value), even if you wouldn't normally have access to that attribute. The modifiers will also display glowing particle effects in their profession's associated color on any weapon they're applied to.

While the ancient anniversary weaponsmith is visiting Embark Beach for the anniversary celebration, you can find unique weapons featuring the reissued weapon skins and the new suffix upgrades.

You can read more details about today's game update on the [url=https://wiki.guildwars.com/wiki/Feedback:Game_updates/20250415][i]Guild Wars[/i] wiki[/url].


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/909b1gw01.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/909b1gw01-590x369.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]20 Years of Guild Wars[/h1]

[i]Guild Wars®[/i] turns 20 years old this month! To celebrate, starting today and for the next two weeks, editions of [i]Guild Wars[/i] are 80% off—their best price ever! This includes the brand-new [i]Guild Wars : The 20th Anniversary Masterpiece Collection[/i], which includes all three campaigns ([i]Prophecies™[/i], [i]Factions™[/i], and [i]Nightfall™[/i]), the [i]Guild Wars : Eye of the North™[/i] expansion, and the Bonus Mission Pack. notes.title: "Repentance" Is Now Live
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=eFarunc4pzU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]"Repentance" Is Live[/h1]
 
Following the events of "Godspawn," the Tyrian Alliance is now aware of a looming threat hidden within the mursaat ruins deep in Janthir. In "Repentance," the second of three major updates for [i]Guild Wars 2®: Janthir Wilds™[/i], you will venture even farther north into the Isles of Janthir, uncover unexpected perils, and end them before Tyria is endangered again. There's plenty of new content to enjoy, so let's dive into it!


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/ef764mistburnedcombat.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/ef764mistburnedcombat-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

 
[h1]What's New?[/h1]

In our [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/news/studio-update-repentance-is-coming-to-guild-wars-2/]previous blog[/url], we explored the origins of Mistburned Barrens and how this fractured landscape came to be. We also [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/news/the-unseen-ones-a-primer-on-the-mursaat/]delved into the lore[/url] of the mursaat, uncovering their influence on the world of Tyria. Now you can experience these stories firsthand with new content, challenges, and rewards. Here are the highlights from this update:
 
[list][*]New Map: Mistburned Barrens[/*]
[*]New Story Chapters[/*]
[*]Raid Challenge Mode for Decima, Greer, and Ura[/*]
[*]Greer, the Blightbringer, Added to the Mount Balrior 50-Player Convergence[/*]
[*]Raid Legendary Mode Added for Ura (Coming March 25)[/*]
[*]12 New Core Relics[/*]
[*]Mursaat Shadowcraft Mastery Track[/*]
[*]New Homestead Decorations, Including Four New Home Instance Nodes[/*]
[*]Many New Rewards, Including Minis, Armor, Weapons, and More[/*][/list]


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/9afbcenUS-gw2-ex5-jw-qr2-wv-refresh-1920x1080.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/9afbcenUS-gw2-ex5-jw-qr2-wv-refresh-1920x1080-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Wizard's Vault Seasonal Refresh[/h1]

The latest rotation in the Wizard's Vault introduces a fresh lineup of must-have rewards. Elevate your relaxation with the Skysage's Throne, an elegant and celestial-inspired seat fit for the most distinguished adventurers. Meanwhile, the Wayward Wisp quest provides players with the opportunity to set forth on a new adventure—exclusive to the Wizard's Vault—that will have you engaging with a wisp that appears on its own whims and rewards players with a forest wisp accessory and infusion.
 
For those looking to bolster their defenses, the Ward Knight's gloves, shoulders, and boots offers a bold and sturdy look, ensuring you stand strong against any challenge. Meanwhile, the Old-Growth Weapons collection brings the power of nature into battle with intricate designs and an organic touch.

[previewyoutube=nokGewFWZsY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Twitch Drops[/h1]

Starting March 11, you can earn exclusive [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/twitch-drops/]Twitch Drops[/url] just by watching your favorite [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] streamers! Watch a total of five hours between 9:00 a.m. Pacific Time (UTC-7) March 11 to 11:59 p.m. Pacific Time (UTC-7) March 16 to unlock all available rewards.
 
Here's what you can earn:
 
[list][*]Mini Lion Cub[/*]
[*]Fuzzy Panda Hat Bundle, which includes the Fuzzy Panda Hat Skin, two Heroic Boosters, and an Upgrade Extractor[/*]
[*]Bag Slot Expansion[/*][/list]

Don't miss out on this chance to add some adorable minis and useful items to your collection!


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/215ebenUS-gw2-ex5-jw-qr2-twitch-drops-1920x1080.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/215ebenUS-gw2-ex5-jw-qr2-twitch-drops-1920x1080-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Fun Events All Spring Long[/h1]
 
While the "Repentance" update is here, the adventure continues with a slate of exciting events on the horizon! On March 25, we're updating the final boss of the Mount Balrior raid, giving Ura a legendary mode that will test the skills of the most dedicated raiders.

Then, April is packed with thrilling festivities, starting with the Dungeon Rush event, where adventurers can push their limits and reap valuable rewards. Following that, the Super Adventure Festival returns with new rewards, bringing nostalgic fun and platforming challenges to all who dare to enter Moto's pixelated world.

May brings even more opportunities to dive into the action. Revisit past adventures in the Return to End of Dragons event, then sharpen your competitive edge with the PvP Rush event. If high-speed thrills are more your style, Roller Beetle Racing Week will let you test your racing prowess. Meanwhile, PvP enthusiasts can look forward to the PvP Push Beta, offering a glimpse at what's next for structured competition.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/17d27enUS-gw2-ex5-jw-qr2-studio-update-roadmap-1920x1080.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/17d27enUS-gw2-ex5-jw-qr2-studio-update-roadmap-1920x1080-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

 
And beyond these events, another major update is on the horizon to close out the Janthir Wilds expansion. Stay tuned for more details, but here's a reminder of what's included in today's update and coming later in the third update!
 
We look forward to seeing you out there exploring Mistburned Barrens!

notes.title: Studio Update: "Repentance" Is Coming to Guild Wars 2
notes.content:
Greetings, Tyrians!

We're thrilled to share details about the next update for [i]Guild Wars 2®: Janthir Wilds™[/i]—"Repentance," launching on March 11. This chapter brings new trials and discoveries to Tyria, including a new map: Mistburned Barrens, a land where strange forces stir and long-buried mursaat secrets begin to surface. Prepare for battles that will challenge even the most seasoned adventurers, along with a host of other exciting updates. Let's dive in, shall we?

[previewyoutube=eFarunc4pzU;full][/previewyoutube]

Picking up where the [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i] story left off in "Godspawn," our allies have just finished their heroic battle against the titans atop Mount Balrior. Ura, Decima, and Greer have been defeated. But this alone has not ended the blight that looms over Janthir, and our journey is not yet done. Upon Ura's death, she claimed that the door that the titans entered Tyria through remains open.

These words rattled Isgarren and Waiting Sorrow, who informed us that Mabon had cast a ward over Bava Nisos, the ruined mursaat city, to hide it and its dangers from the rest of the world. But with his death, that ward fell, and somewhere inside a Mists gate sits open. 
 
When work began on [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i], we knew that we would be exploring mysteries that have been teased since the release of the original [i]Guild Wars®[/i], which we're celebrating the 20th anniversary of this year . From the fall of the mursaat at the titans' claws to the many misdeeds of the White Mantle—these are some of Tyria’s darkest, bloodiest moments. Now, you and your allies must venture further into the isles of Janthir to reveal these long-forgotten histories. Maybe, with this knowledge, we can cleanse Janthir once and for all.
 
We've traveled from the comforts of home in Lowland Shore into the stormy, damp woods of Janthir Syntri. Now, we must sail to the ruined home of the mursaat to figure out what Ura warned us of—starting just outside of Bava Nisos, in Mistburned Barrens. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/833c5c3e1e9ba481efdb9cfa4b86cc82d8f06298.jpg[/img]

[h1]Mistburned Barrens[/h1]

As the Tyrian Alliance sets out to explore the ruins of Bava Nisos, they face a uniquely hazardous environment. Even though hundreds of years have passed since the Door of Komalie was opened, the barrens are still fraught with the remains of mursaat experiments in spectral agony and long saturated with bloodstone magic and Mistburn. The ghosts of the mursaat and their victims cling to the land, forever haunting this cursed place.

To safely explore this grim landscape, the Tyrian Alliance has put together survey parties to unravel the mysteries buried within the crumbling corridors. Players will be able to participate in three unique surveys from the base camp at the ruins' mouth:

[list][*]To the north, players will reactivate an enormous, dormant construct and use it to cross a spectral agony-flooded valley.[/*]
[*]In the center, players will utilize asuran golems to delve into an ancient library and investigate the Mistburn that has spread across the isles of Janthir.[/*]
[*]Players in the south will lead a procession of Tyrian Alliance members into a laboratory once utilized for bloodstone sacrifices and experimentation.[/*][/list]
 
From a design perspective, our goal is to ensure that anytime a player enters the map there are rewarding, structured events that you can jump right into. Now, to investigate the buzzing sound that scouts have reported emanating from the woods…


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/ae316gw972.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/ae316gw972-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]New Arrivals[/h1]

Next week's "Repentance" update brings several exciting additions to [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i], including the highly anticipated challenge mode for the Mount Balrior raid. If you've been searching for your next raid challenge, this is your chance to join the race for world-first completion as guilds push the limits of coordination, strategy, and execution. And for those seeking the ultimate trial, the final boss, Ura, will be available as a legendary mode encounter on March 25. We plan to stagger the release of challenge mode and legendary mode releases like this going forward to give ourselves an opportunity to address encounter balance concerns before the legendary mode is released.

Greer, the Blightbringer, will also make his debut in the Mount Balrior Convergence, which will add variation to the final boss you encounter there. Expect familiar mechanics executed in new, unpredictable ways that will keep your group on their toes.


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/8052agw948.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/8052agw948-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]


With the addition of a new map and story chapters, we're introducing the Mursaat Shadowcraft Mastery track. For lore enthusiasts, we recently explored mursaat history and its ties to [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i] in a [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/news/the-unseen-ones-a-primer-on-the-mursaat/]Narrative team blog[/url]. If you're curious about the origins of the mursaat, this deep dive will provide insight into their role in the story and even offer hints about the upcoming Mastery track.

New relics will also be available to further customize your builds. If you missed our recent developer stream, the Balance team showcased some of these new relics; catch the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2362467560]full VOD[/url] on our Twitch channel.

And of course, a new release means new rewards, including updates to the Wizard's Vault and Twitch Drops. Stay tuned for next week's blog, where we'll dive into all the details!


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/7ba2cWvW02.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/7ba2cWvW02-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

 
[h1]World vs. World Updates[/h1]

In the March 11 update, we're introducing a long-awaited quality-of-life improvement aimed at improving the visibility of WvW guild membership. A new column in the Guild panel's second tab will display an icon next to all members who have designated that guild as their WvW guild. However, this information will only be visible within the guild you have personally selected as your WvW guild.
 
Looking ahead to the March 25 update, the WvW team is focused on refining the WvW rewards system, tackling performance issues, and implementing adjustments based on player feedback, along with other quality-of-life improvements. Several key changes are on the horizon, including:
 
[list][*]Consolidation of reward tracks to enhance accessibility.[/*]
[*]Improved map-currency acquisition via reward tracks.[/*]
[*]Addition of a brand-new WvW weapon set.[/*]
[*]New restrictions on tactivator use for keeps and Stonemist Castle.[/*]
[*]Tuning the health pools of keep lords.[/*]
[*]Updating victory points and skirmish values, refining how progress and success are measured in WvW.[/*][/list]
  
[h1]PvP Push Game Mode[/h1]

Late last year, we ran the first beta event for the new Push PvP game mode, giving players a glimpse into our development process and an opportunity to provide feedback on our prototype. The event was well received, generating a wealth of player feedback through participant surveys.

Since then, we've been working on updates to refine the mode based on that input. We're excited to announce that another beta event is planned for May 20 to May 26, giving players another chance to experience the mode and share their thoughts. We'll reveal more details about the changes as we get closer to the event date.

[h1]Guild Wars 2 in the Spring[/h1]

While "Repentance" is only a week away, several festivals and bonus events are happening before the launch of our third [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i] update later this year. Take a look at what is coming up this spring:
 

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/17d27enUS-gw2-ex5-jw-qr2-studio-update-roadmap-1920x1080.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/17d27enUS-gw2-ex5-jw-qr2-studio-update-roadmap-1920x1080-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

 
[h3][b]March[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]March 11[/b]—[i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i]: "Repentance"[/*]
[*][b]March 25[/b]—Ura Raid Legendary Mode and WvW Quality-of-Life Updates[/*][/list]

[h3][b]April[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]April 8–April 15[/b]—Dungeon Rush Bonus Event[/*]
[*][b]April 15–May 6[/b]—Super Adventure Festival[/*]
[*][b]April 15[/b]—Skills and Balance Update[/*]
[*][b]April 25–May 2[/b]—WvW No Downed State Bonus Event[/*][/list]

[h3][b]May[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]May 6–May 20[/b]—Return to End of Dragons Bonus Event[/*]
[*][b]May 13–May 20[/b]—Roller Beetle Racing Bonus Event[/*]
[*][b]May 20–May 27[/b]—PvP Push Beta and Rush Bonus Event[/*][/list]
 
And finally, as a reminder of what’s still to come in [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i] during the final two updates, we have this handy content chart:


[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/13e6benUS-gw2-ex5-jw-studio-update-feature-table.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/13e6benUS-gw2-ex5-jw-studio-update-feature-table-590x662.jpg[/img][/url]

  
Stay tuned to our social media channels for more info regarding "Repentance" and we’ll be back next week with a launch blog covering the main features and rewards. Happy adventuring!

—The [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] Team//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/48f59JF218.jpg
//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/4cec7JF214.jpg

notes.title: Game Update Notes: January 14, 2025
notes.content:
[h1]01/14/2025—January 14 Release Notes[/h1]

Note to users of third-party programs: The game may not launch or work properly after we release a new build if you use a third-party program, due to possible incompatibilities. ArenaNet cannot offer support if a third-party modification breaks, interferes with, or prevents you from playing Guild Wars or Guild Wars 2. Our policy regarding third-party programs can be found [url=https://help.guildwars2.com/hc/en-us/articles/360013625034-Policy-Third-Party-Programs]here[/url].

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a terrain issue in Lowland Shore that prevented some wisps in the Tales of the Lowland Wisps collection from reaching their destination, blocking progress.
[*] Fixed an issue in Lowland Shore that prevented some wisps in the Tales of the Lowland Wisps collection from being interacted with when their objective was unlocked but still incomplete, blocking progress.
[/list]

[h3]Dragon Response Missions[/h3]

Dragon Response missions have been updated in preparation for the Return to Icebrood Saga bonus event. These changes allow the preparation phase objective to scale properly for group size; the number of objectives to clear the phase for a group of five players will be slightly reduced from the previous state, while the number for solo players will be greatly reduced.

[list]
[*] Removed the five-minute timer for the preparation phase events and replaced it with a progress objective that fills as players participate in the event's subobjectives. Progress is still gained if the individual subobjective has been completed. Morale boosts can still be gained if the three subobjectives are completed; the requirements for these objectives do not scale and have been significantly lowered.
[*] Fixed various pathing issues that could leave characters in awkward positions.
[*] Cleaned up a number of marker display issues and inaccurate skill text for events.
[*] Fixed a number of small NPC issues to improve event performance.
[/list]

notes.title: 2024-12-10 - December 10th Release Notes
notes.content:
Release Notes:
Note to users of third-party programs: The game may not launch or work properly after we release a new build if you use a third-party program, due to possible incompatibilities. ArenaNet cannot offer support if a third-party modification breaks, interferes with, or prevents you from playing Guild Wars or Guild Wars 2. Our policy regarding third-party programs can be found here. [note: this will be a permanent note that will be included in all release notes. Do not remove from template.]

[h1]Wintersday[/h1]

Come join us in celebrating Wintersday - Toymaker Tixx has made his annual visit to Divinity's Reach to spread seasonal cheer and festivity! Bring the cheer of Wintersday to the distant north in the Secret Lair of the Snowmen, complete daily achievements to earn fanciful holiday weapons, save Wintersday for the orphans spread around Divinity’s Reach by giving them wrapped gifts, test your snow-throwing skills against other players in Snowball Mayhem, experience the joy of jumping in Winter Wonderland, defend against waves of toys in Toypocalypse, and help keep Tixx’s airship The Infinirarium in order! You will also see Wintersday gifts appearing all around Tyria.

[list]
[*] The Wintersday annual meta achievement 'Wintersday Traditions' has been updated with a new armor reward, the Winter Mittens - keep your sword hand warded from frosty shivers! Last year's meta reward, the Winter Fur Shoulders, can now be purchased at the festival rewards vendors.
[*] A new Plush weapon set is now available!  You'll receive your choice of a weapon by progressing the annual Wintersday Traditions meta achievement, or the weekly Wintersday Festivities achievement.
[*] Wintersday Festivities, along with the corresponding weekly achievements in other festivals, now reward their weapon box before their festival material.
[*] The Sacred Solstice weapon set is now available on the Weekly Wintersday vendors.
[*] Four new weapons are now available as a rare drop from Wintersday gifts. They can also be purchased from Sparking Stone in Divinity's Reach.
[*] A new mini pet has been added to Wintersday vendors: the adorable Plush Fox.
[*] Deft Lahar is visiting Divinity's Reach for the festival, and has a variety of Homestead-tailored recipes for your favorite Wintersday decorations to offer.
[*] New winter themed guild decorations have been added:
[*] Jolly Bow
[*] Icicle
[*] Star Light String
[*] Sparkle Light String
[*] The offseason Wintersday Vendor in Hooligan's Route now stocks a much greater amount of Wintersday items for customers who find themselves with excess Snowflakes after Tixx has closed up his workshop for the year, including the recipes for Homestead decorations.
[*] A number of festival-related bugs have been fixed to ensure a happy holiday for all heroes.
[*] To ensure that festivalgoers have ample time to enjoy the holiday, Wintersday will be active until January 2nd at noon PST.  See you in Divinity's Reach!
[/list]

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated Guild Banners to improve quality of life and reduce buff icon clutter
[*] The Guild Heroes Banner's multiple buffs have been consolidated to a single buff for its reward boosts and a buff for the Swiftness effect
[*] Guild banners whose effect was less than the equivalent effect of the Guild Heroes Banner - for example, the basic Karma Banner's 5% Karma boost - are now increased to match the Heroes Banner.
[*] Interacting with a lesser banner while under the effect of a Guild Heroes Banner will now refresh its duration, if its duration was lower than the banner would provide.
[*] Removed the non-Heroes banners from the Guild Commendation vendors, since they were extremely inefficient compared to the price of the Guild Heroes Banner.
[*] Reduced the recharge time of Guild Banners and Feasts when deployed from the Guild Storage.  
[*] Several books have been added to the story instances in Janthir Wilds chapters 11, 12, and 13.
[*] Players who have acquired the four gifts needed to make Klobjarne Geirr and have unlocked the legendary spear's skin can talk to Unending Tribute to fully complete the Legendary Weapon: Klobjarne Geirr Gifts achievement. This is to help players who have had some of the components prior to the introduction of this achievement and did not retroactively check progress. 
[*] The "Mini Blue Cuckoo Hatchling" and the "Mini Orange Tigris Cub" have now been added to the Black Lion Chest Merchants for 5 Black Lion Statuettes. 
[*] Janthir Syntri: Fixed a bug where small chests at Stricken Plains were not guaranteeing Charged Titan Ore when opened. 
[*] Fixed an animation bug on the Ruinshard Shambler Rampage attack so it's not interrupted 
[*] Purchasing the Standing Stones Timepiece and Bearkin War Helm remnants progress the respective item in the Legendary Spear: Klobjarne Geirr achievement. Players can also load into Lowland Shore to retroactively check if they have completed the Lowland Shore Mastery or Janthir Syntri Mastery achievements.
[*] Homesteads
[*] Updated the centering and alignment of many weapon skins on the Weapon Display Case decoration. 
[*] A cuddly new Homestead decoration is available for players who've completed the Build-a-Quaggan collection. 
[/list]

[h1]Raids[/h1]
Mount Balrior

[list]
[*] Decima: Focused Fluxlance now only requires three players in the beam instead of five. Because base damage is divided among players, the base damage was also reduced to keep final damage numbers consistent. 
[*] Decima: Fixed a bug causing players to be miscounted by Focused Fluxlance. The mechanic will now fail consistently if too few players soak the beam. 
[*] Decima: Defiance increased by 25%. However, the channel for Flux Nova is now shortened when Decima's Defiance is broken and she gains Fractured Armor. 
[*] Decima: Peal of Harmony is now gained every 5% damage taken instead of every 3% damage taken. This will reduce the number of Dancing Sparks generated overall. 
[*] Decima: Fixed a few issues causing the telegraphs for Decima's various Fluxlance attacks to be invisible to some players. 
[*] Decima: When Decima is defeated any telegraphed Fluxlance attacks will be interrupted and clean up immediately. 
[*] Decima: To provide a little extra time to position for Focused Fluxlance, all Fluxlance attacks in Phase 3 now have an extra half-second of warmup time before they fire. 
[*] Decima: Characters squashed because they were standing directly under Decima during Earthrend and Seismic Crash are now instead downed and knocked away. 
[*] Decima: Fixed a bug preventing Fluxlance in Phase 1 from targeting Downed characters. 
[*] Greer: Greer no longer has permanent Resolution. 
[*] Greer: Enfeebling Miasma attack region now matches its warning areas, and lingering gas clouds have area warning circles 
[*] Greer: Greer's projectiles can no longer be reflected back at him. Those projectiles will instead be destroyed, keeping the protective utility of the affected skills 
[*] Greer: Surviving Empowering Beasts are now cleaned up when Greer is slain
[*] Greer: Blob of Blight now correctly stays in place after it hits a targeted player, and smaller projectiles are now properly destroyed on impact 
[*] Greer: Greer's first two stomp attacks in his Stomp the Mould skill are now blockable and Dodgeable 
[*] Greer: Greer should now attack pets less often 
[*] Ura: Fixed an issue which could cause the Sulfuric Acid debuff to persist after defeating the boss 
[*] Ura: Added additional telegraphing for players targeted by Ura's Eruption Vent ability 
[*] General: Players are now properly notified about the new raid through an alert. 
[*] General: Dialogue does not repeat on re-entering the raid if they have progressed past that point 
[*] General: Fixed a bug causing unintended scaling on the two Legendary Titanspawn events. 
[*] General: Fixed a couple edge cases which could result in the Legendary Titanspawn events stalling. 
[*] General: Fixed a bug that allowed characters to leave Greer and Decima's arenas mid fight
[/list]
. 
[h1]General[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing some professions and elite specializations to miss out on having their resources refreshed and cooldowns reset when an encounter begins if the player was mounted at the time of the refresh. 
[/list]

[h1]Profession Skills[/h1]
[list]
[*] Elementalist
[*] Volcano: Fixed an issue that prevented this skill from creating attacks on certain terrain.
[/list]

notes.title: “Celebrate” Evon Gnashblade’s “Birthday” with Great Savings
notes.content:
Mark your calendars for a special Black Lion Trading Company event as Captain Evon Gnashblade invites you to a unique “birthday” celebration in Lion’s Arch. You don’t give Evon gifts on his “birthday”—instead, he provides deep discounts and spectacular offers!

From November 25 to December 2, the Black Lion Vaults will open with exclusive offerings and a chance to trade materials for a few limited-time surprises. There will also be new vendors, new displays, and a whole new look to the Vaults, so get ready to head over to Lion’s Arch next week.

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/55d32Blog-VaultDoors_01.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/55d32Blog-VaultDoors_01-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Evon’s “Birthday” Deals[/h1]

Players logging in during the event will receive their “birthday” invitation in the mail encouraging them to visit the Vaults in Lion’s Arch. The message comes with a cinematic highlighting the location, setting the stage for the festivities. Here’s what you can expect during the event:

[list][*][b]30% Off Black Lion Chest Keys:[/b] What savings! As part of the celebration, Black Lion Chest Keys are discounted by 30%, giving you the chance to unlock even more of the treasures Evon has carefully curated. The discount runs through the event dates, so be sure to take advantage of it before time runs out. Isn’t Evon so generous?[/*]
[*][b]Material Exchange:[/b] Evon also wants to help you clean out your cluttered inventory! During the event, you can exchange select materials for limited rewards, such as 250 Large Claws for a Guaranteed Wardrobe Unlock, and 150 Vicious Fangs for 3 Black Lion Chest Keys. Head to the Black Lion “Birthday” Manager vendor in the Vaults to see everything that is available.[/*]
[*][b]Wizard Vault:[/b] For those looking to earn a little extra recognition, completing a Wizard’s Vault objective will reward you with a little bonus of Astral Acclaim. It’s Evon’s way of showing you how much he cares about you on his “birthday.”
The Vaults Get a Fresh Look[/*][/list]

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/1237fBlog-MountDisplay_03.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/1237fBlog-MountDisplay_03-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

Evon’s “birthday” isn’t just about discounts—it’s also an opportunity to experience the permanent changes in Lion’s Arch. Evon has literally blown the doors off the Vaults to make room for more inventory and show you the incredible items he has in stock!

The Vaults will now have new displays showcasing mounts, outfits, and other items in Evon’s inventory.  These displays give a peek at what’s available for your character’s wardrobe and collections. Expect these displays to be updated every season, offering new looks as the items rotate.

Whether you “celebrate” by grabbing discounted items or by taking advantage of the more convenient trading post vendor, there’s no better time than Evon Gnashblade’s “Birthday” Celebration to head to Lion’s Arch and check out the Vaults!

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/2c99bBlog-ArmorOutfit_01.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/2c99bBlog-ArmorOutfit_01-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Live Now: "Godspawn," First Major Update for Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Jrol0Nr8q_Q;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]"Godspawn" Is Live[/h1]

Today we're excited to lift the curtain and launch the first major update for Guild Wars 2®: Janthir Wilds™—”Godspawn”! This update contains three new story chapters to continue the expansion's story and set the commander on a difficult journey as they go against the titan forces.

As a reminder, this update—and the other two major updates to follow in 2025—are automatically unlocked for owners of the [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i] expansion! expansion! You can check out all the details of today's update in the [url=https://en-forum.guildwars2.com/topic/153597-game-update-notes-november-19-2024/]full release notes[/url] on our official forums.

To begin this content, players must have completed up through Chapter 3, “Home Sweet Home” in the Janthir Wilds story journal tab. Once completed, players can choose to skip ahead by selecting “11. Trial and Error,” and clicking “Play This Chapter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/3c46d3d278e474d2f83650ce7e730577c3a307dc.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/df4d0793ef4d85d2086292efd9975e5ae8df75ed.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/fa145f4b652223adabb3430261261f5d69b0c4ba.jpg[/img]

[h1]What's New?[/h1]

Many of the details for "Godspawn" were discussed in our recent [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/news/studio-update-wrapping-up-2024]studio update blog[/url]. As a quick recap, you can experience the following when you jump into the game today:

[list]
[*] Three new story chapters
[*] A new ten-person raid—our first in five years
[*] A new fifty-person Convergence, with public and squad-based challenges against legendary titans
[*] A new legendary spear, Klobjarne Geirr
[*] A new Mastery tier
[*] A Wizard's Vault seasonal refresh
[*] Additional expansion relics
[*] New homestead decorations
[*] Many new rewards, including minis, guild decorations, armor, weapons, and more
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/b4c39c8e66447469d79159adaa24afce5a8c7bd4.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/12b9f22f7bf6625baf5a3d44568705bd0136010d.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/d466192073e82c20288e787ad34fdd7c66645629.jpg[/img]

[h1]Legendary Spear: Klobjarne Geirr[/h1]

In case you missed it, we recently released a trailer for the new legendary spear, Klobjarne Geirr, showcasing it in all its glory! This storied weapon once belonged to the nameless Claw who, thousands of years ago, led the kodan south, guiding his people to safety from the Dragonstorm. With six unique cosmetic styles, the Klobjarne Spear lets you align its appearance with your fashion preference. Its intricate design reflects the legacy of a spear that saved countless lives and its elegance shines in motion. If you haven't seen the trailer yet, it's worth a look to truly appreciate this legendary weapon's full potential!

[previewyoutube=vN6bLKUcTLg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Wizard's Vault Seasonal Refresh[/h1]

The Astral Ward  has conjured up a new season of the Wizard's Vault filled with exciting new objectives. Complete them to earn astral acclaim—yours to spend on a trove of new and returning rewards! 

This season's treasures include the playful Dog Bench Chair for lounging with a pack of loyal hounds, the Enchanted Warclaw Mount Skin, the shadowy Rot Stalker armor to add an ominous edge to your look, and the spine-chilling Alabaster Spider's weapon set to unleash some real creep factor. And don't worry—rewards from the previous  season are available in the Legacy Rewards tab, so you can unlock exclusive cosmetics from previous seasons at your own pace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/f37fc29ae942a4028b9a2434742d5355bb37ba9a.jpg[/img]

The wizards weren't only busy creating new achievements and rewards. Players who purchase a Legendary Weapon Starter Key can use it to teleport to the Mists Vault, where they can choose from a selection of four legendary starter kits and begin their journey toward a legendary weapon. Members of the Astral Ward are also on hand to help explain the road to crafting a legendary weapon and conjure previews of the weapons you'll be choosing from. If you'd like to visit and take in the view of the Mists without a starter key, you can speak with Field Archivist Cierle inside the Mists Vault or Sarettokk in Lion's Arch to obtain a Mists Vault access key.

[previewyoutube=EbO3QPaUbWU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Twitch Drops[/h1]

'Tis the season to get cozy around the homestead fireplace, and what better way to do it in style than with some festive [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/twitch-drops]Twitch Drops[/url]! From November 19 at 9:00 a.m. Pacific Time (UTC-7) to November 24 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific Time (UTC-7), you'll be able to watch your favorite [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] stream and snag some awesome regards! Here's what you can unlock when you watch:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/bf7259ff7a6c0c838db886c90a0b206b99bebeb9.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] One hour of viewing time: 5 Transmutation Charges
[*] Two hours of viewing time: Festive Hat Skin 
[*] Four hours of viewing time: Snowflake Glider 
[*] Seven hours of viewing time: Winter Solstice Outfit
[/list]

[h1]More Guild Wars 2 Happenings[/h1]

Here's what's on the horizon for [i]Guild Wars 2[/i], including its exciting debut on the [url=https://www.guildwars2.com/news/guild-wars-2-is-now-on-the-epic-games-store/]Epic Games Store[/url]! The upcoming New Heroes Jump Start event will welcome players old and new, with opportunities to boost their progress and earn extra rewards as they dive into the adventure. Anticipated quality-of-life improvements are also on the way for World vs. World, creating a smoother and more dynamic battlefield experience for all. Early next year, players can expect impactful skills and balance improvements, plus fresh additions to the Wizard's Vault.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38608049/8b65d0cc9ca1094a6cd96436acda4e4f2e9a4a7b.jpg[/img]

Wintersday will bring three weeks of festive cheer, and the Lunar New Year celebration will return early next year, filling the Crown Pavilion in Divinity's Reach with lively activities to mark the Canthan new year. Alongside these seasonal highlights, bonus events focused on returning to past content releases will provide even more ways for players to earn rewards and dive into the action.

There will be some more events and surprises as we head into 2025 and into our next release, so stay tuned to the official [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] channels to stay in the loop!

notes.title: Studio Update: Wrapping Up 2024
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Jrol0Nr8q_Q;full][/previewyoutube]
Greetings, Tyrians!

It's hard to believe it's already been a few months since [i]Guild Wars 2®: Janthir Wilds™[/i] launched. As we wind down 2024, we'd like to give the community an update about all things [i]Guild Wars 2[/i]. Our fifth expansion added one of the most requested features to the game—homesteads—and it's been wonderful watching the creativity of players as they decorate their new homes. You also got to experience the beauty of Lowland Shores and survive the dangers of Janthir Syntri with your new allies, the lowland kodan. With the kodans' help, you were taught to wield spears and ride the warclaw like you never have before. But [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i] has just begun, and in one week, you'll be able to join forces to tackle our first raid in five years, craft a new legendary spear, and continue your story with the lowland kodan.

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/c70f7StudioUpdate-gw596.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/c70f7StudioUpdate-gw596-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds—"Godspawn"[/h1]

"Godspawn," the first of three major updates to [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i], is coming on November 19.  Three new story chapters will continue your adventure against the threat of the titans. Will you and your allies be able to uncover a path to securing peace for the inhabitants of the Isles of Janthir?

In addition to new story chapters, there will also be a new raid and Convergence, the new legendary spear, Klobjarne, along with a new Wizard's Vault season, relics, weapon and armor rewards, a Mastery update, and new homestead decorations! 

Stay tuned for previews of the new rewards and Wizard's Vault refresh in our launch day blog!

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/58805StudioUpdate-Raids-5.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/58805StudioUpdate-Raids-5-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Raids Are Back![/h1]

In next week's update, we will be introducing our new 10-person raid, which will take you to Mount Balrior. It features three bosses and several smaller, varied encounters that will test your coordination and adaptability. 

At the heart of Mount Balrior's narrative are Greer, the Blightbringer, and Decima, the Stormsinger, the two titans you battled in Janthir Syntri. After their defeat, they've retreated to Mount Balrior to recover and regroup. This time, they won't be alone. Their raid versions bring back the chaotic, relentless attacks of Greer and the structured, strategic mechanics of Decima, but cranked up to new levels of intensity. Expect familiar moves executed in ways that will keep your group on their toes, along with a few completely new surprises that Greer and Decima have in store.

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/d99c0StudioUpdate-Convergence-22.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/d99c0StudioUpdate-Convergence-22-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Embark on the New Convergence in Lowland Shore[/h1]

For a different flavor of group content, we are also launching a new Convergence in the "Godspawn" update! Like the Convergence in [i]Guild Wars 2®: Secrets of the Obscure™[/i], up to 50 players can participate in public squads every three hours, with private squads able to start any time. Expect a challenge comparable to the [i]Guild Wars 2: Secrets of the Obscure[/i] Convergence bosses, with most groups completing it in 20-30 minutes. 

In this journey, Stoic Alder, the Claw of the lowland kodan, narrates your adventure to young kodan cubs, adding unique story twists with every playthrough. Fans of Greer and Decima will find familiar attacks, but with adaptations that make this event a fresh experience. As our first multi-purpose map, Mount Balrior includes hidden passages and adaptive designs, setting the stage for future rotations of bosses and a challenge mode arriving later next year. 

Stay tuned as we dive deeper into what's next for both raids and Convergences in an upcoming blog later this week! 

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/9ecc8StudioUpdate-gw034.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/9ecc8StudioUpdate-gw034-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]World vs. World (WvW) Updates[/h1]

Our team is focused on refining core systems in WvW while we continue planning for some of our larger, long-term goals. One major area of focus is incentivizing winning—or, in other words, creating shared goals that encourage teamwork. We've consistently heard two key pieces of feedback: players often have different preferences for defending versus not defending, and, more generally, many players feel there aren't enough incentives to win matchups. By aligning team goals around winning, we hope to address both these issues. It's a big task, but it's one we're dedicated to, and we're excited to start rolling out improvements.

We're also making some significant scoring adjustments for the first time in a while. This is an essential step in aligning player goals and encouraging teams to prioritize winning together. We've updated PPK (points per kill) values, the points for capturing objectives, and will soon launch adjusted VP (Victory Point) numbers tailored to different time zone coverage.

In the short term, we've been updating several key parts of WvW game elements. We've overhauled the siege system, improved the participation system to make earning repel credit more consistent, and introduced new attribute combinations exclusive to WvW (alongside tweaks to existing ones that don't impact PvE). We're also working to adjust certain tactics and strengthen objective lords to better serve as rally points for defenders. To make WvW more rewarding, we've added unique skins, infusions, new ways to spend WvW currencies, and better skirmish track rewards. 

Accessibility for new players is a key goal, too. The warclaw is now immediately available in WvW, mastering it is faster, and new exotic gear with selectable attributes is readily obtainable. 

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/51facStudioUpdate-gw039.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/51facStudioUpdate-gw039-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]World vs. World Restructuring and Competitive Updates[/h1]

The World Restructuring team is currently focused on larger improvements to the team-creation algorithm, with special consideration given to improving the issue described in this [url=https://en-forum.guildwars2.com/topic/148182-world-restructuring-status-update/]forum post[/url]. 

We're also enhancing the guild panel with a new UI element that displays which members have selected the guild as their WvW guild, making it easier for guilds to coordinate their World vs. World activities and avoid missing team-creation lockout deadlines.
 
Additionally, we're updating the character select screen, replacing World Selection with a Region Selection UI panel. This will allow seamless transfers between North American and European datacenters. With this change, intra-region transfers will no longer be necessary, which also eliminates the risk of spending gems on redundant world transfers. Regional transfers will now have a flat cost of 500 gems simplifying the process.

Also, for players who took part in our PvP Push beta event, we recently sent out a survey to gather feedback on the event, and we'll be reviewing the responses and then determining our next steps for the game mode. There will be more Push news in 2025 as we continue to work with the community on building the Push PvP mode.

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/d1c92StudioUpdate-Convergence-05.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/d1c92StudioUpdate-Convergence-05-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Guild Wars 2 on the Epic Games Store![/h1]

[i]Guild Wars 2[/i] will be making its debut on the Epic Games Store later this month, and we're thrilled to welcome a new batch of players to the world of Tyria. [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] has been captivating players for the past 12 years, and we are excited to make Tyria even more accessible to players by partnering with Epic. 

Keep a look out on our official platforms for a release date (and an epic new [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] trailer) soon!

[h1]Wrapping Up 2024[/h1]

While the year may be coming to a close soon, there's still plenty of things coming up for [i]Guild Wars 2[/i]. November and December will also include more events: a two-week New Hero Jump Start event, a "birthday" bash for Evon Gnashblade, and Wintersday coming up on December 10. Lunar New Year and a second skills and balance update will be coming along near the end of January 2025. Around then—or a little after—we'll be back to talk about the next few months of [i]Guild Wars 2[/i].

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/88985enUS-gw2-ex5-jw-qr1-studio-update-roadmap-1920x1080.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/88985enUS-gw2-ex5-jw-qr1-studio-update-roadmap-1920x1080-590x332.jpg[/img][/url]

Here are some dates for our upcoming events to close out the year:

[list][*]October 29–November 19: Extra Life In-Game Bonus[/*]
[*]November 12–November 25: New Hero Jump Start Event [/*]
[*]November 25–December 2: Evon Gnashblade's "Birthday" Celebration[/*]
[*]December 10–January 2: Wintersday Event[/*][/list]
 
And finally, as a reminder of what's still to come in [i]Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds[/i] in 2025, we have this handy content chart:

[url=//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/74623enUS-gw2-ex5-jw-studio-update-launch.jpg][img]//d3b4yo2b5lbfy.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/74623enUS-gw2-ex5-jw-studio-update-launch-590x662.jpg[/img][/url]

Happy adventuring! We'll see you in the game.

—The [i]Guild Wars 2[/i] Team

notes.content:

Note to users of third-party programs: The game may not launch or work properly after we release a new build if you use a third-party program, due to possible incompatibilities. notes.title: Game Update Notes: October 15, 2024
notes.content:
[h1]10/15/2024—Shadow of the Mad King Release Notes [/h1]
[h2]Release Notes:[/h2]
[b]Halloween[/b]

Once again, the gates of the Mad Realm have opened, and Kryta's most infamous monarch, Mad King Thorn, has returned to hold court in Lion's Arch! Loyal vassals of the king are strongly encouraged to enjoy the festivities: meet the denizens of the Mad Realm in events across Kryta; tour the Mad Realm itself in the Mad King's Labyrinth and the fearsome Clock Tower; compete with your fellow mortals in Lunatic Inquisition, Reaper's Rumble, and the Mad King's Raceway; attend to the king's whims in his notorious pastime of Mad King Says; or match wits and blades against royalty in Ascent to Madness.
The Lion's Arch Captain's Council wishes to remind the populace that they are not affiliated with the Krytan monarchy and cannot guarantee the safety of any citizens who choose to dabble in dangerous realms, mad or otherwise.

[list]
[*] The (Annual) Halloween Rituals meta-achievement has been updated with a fashionable new reward, the Clawing Shadow Plate! Earn this spooky new armor piece by completing a variety of Halloween activities and show your allegiance to the Mad King's court with pride. Last year's meta reward, the Clawing Shadow Greaves, can now be purchased from Halloween vendors if you missed it.
[*] A new Candy Core weapon set is now available! You'll receive your choice of a weapon by progressing the (Annual) Halloween Rituals meta-achievement or the (Weekly) Halloween Festivities achievement.
[*] The Grim Machine weapon set is now available from the weekly Halloween vendors.
[*] Three new weapons are now available in the Courtly Weapon Chest, which is rarely found in trick-or-treat bags. They can also be purchased from Sparking Stone in Lion's Arch.
[*] An unsettling new Mini Pummel Spider has been added to Halloween vendors.
[*] Deft Lahar is visiting Lion's Arch for the festival and is offering a variety of handiwork recipes for homestead versions of your favorite Halloween decorations.
[*] New Halloween-themed decorations have been added: 
[list][*] Haunted Bell, suitable for trick-or-treating in your guild hall or homestead
[*] Antique Bell, for a less spooky announcement of visitors to the guild hall or homestead
[*] Gargoyle
[*] Flame-Bearing Gargoyle
[*] Warclaw Rental Post[/list]
[*] The Wizard's Vault has been updated with special objectives for participating in Halloween activities.
[*] The Halloween vendor in Hooligan's Route now stocks a much larger variety of Halloween items for customers who find themselves with excess candy corn after the doors to the Mad Realm close for the year, including the recipes for homestead decorations.
[*] The (Annual) Raceway Regular achievement now receives additional progress for laps completed within the gold-medal time for their race.
[*] Checkpoints in the Mad King's Raceway have had their visual size increased to more consistently match their collision area.
[*] Many small bugs have been polished to ensure a more fun festival than ever for all visitors to the Mad Realm. [/list]

The gates to the Mad Realm will be open for three weeks, from October 15 until November 5. Have a happy Halloween!
